# Context Pack: `sprint-verify-transition` — Verify review-to-smoke transition Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose `Service.Verify` is the single promotion boundary between execute evidence and quality assessment. It composes four policies and delegates their effects: 1. **Execute completeness** (`requireCompleteExecute`): every execute task terminal (complete/deferred) plus a non-blank `execute.md`, before any verification work. 2. **Review freshness/currentness**: recompute review currentness from current bytes/governed inputs; reuse canonical review evidence only when fresh+completed; otherwise run the full conformance review. 3. **Diagnostic override ladder**: after a completed-but-failing review, continuation into smoke requires the explicit flag trio (`--force-review` + confirmation + non-empty rationale); stale/blocked reviews are never overridable. 4. **Smoke continuation** through the smoke gate (`RunSmoke`), which independently re-validates the review gate at decision time. The stated enforcement goal: diagnostic results can never become canonical assessment — implemented by `deriveAssessment` ignoring overrides entirely and by diagnostic-only smoke never committing artifacts/state. ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 CLI `sprint

verify [...]` (`internal/app/sprint_commands.go:280-328`) - `parseSprintVerifyArgs` (:1119-1191): default `To=smoke`; `--to` restricted to review|smoke (:1172); `--focus-review` accumulates; `--restart-review` conflicts with focus (:1175); at most one of `--level/--suite/--test` (:1178-1186); `--timeout` parsed, positive, ≤24h; `--force-review` requires `--override-reason` (:1187); `--yes/--non-interactive` sets both `Smoke.NonInteractive` and `Smoke.OverrideConfirmed`; `--dry-run` propagates into Review and Smoke sub-requests. - Pre-flight CLI gate (:285-287): `To==smoke && !DryRun && !Smoke.NonInteractive` → ExitUsage "— --yes is required for smoke execution". - Non-dry-run wraps the command in a durable run-control operation (`beginDurableCLICommand`, OperationVerifyStart; durable_operations.go:49-60 — repository Accept → Claim with owner lease + fencing generation → lifecycle running event → cancellation-aware ctx watched by `controlOperation` heartbeat/cancel polling :223-264), rebuilds a runtime-backed service via `sprintRuntimeService` (:685-711), and wires progress rendering. - Calls `verifyService.Verify` (:303); error mapping distinguishes `AsSmokeError` → `mapSmokeError` else `mapSprintError("sprint.verify", …)` (:305-312). JSON envelope `{schema_version:1, operation:"sprint.verify", status:, result, error?}` (:313-318); text output via `renderSprintVerification` (:1282-1302). Exit classes (app.go:16-24): usage=2, validation=5, runtime=6, partial=8; success-path fail/blocked assessments exit 5 (:325-327). ### 2.2 `Service.Verify` (`internal/sprint/verify.go:39-95`) - Lease once up front for non-dry-run via `acquireMutationContext` (:40-47); nested `Review`/`RunSmoke` reuse it through the context marker (locks.go). - Default `To=smoke`; reject anything but review|smoke (:48-53). - `requireCompleteExecute` (:55; impl :97-132): `LoadExecuteRunState`; on load failure falls back to reading raw `.run-state.json` as `{status:"complete"|"completed", files:[…]}` plus readable non-blank `execute.md` (legacy summary shape :104-116). Loaded state must have ≥1 task, all tasks `complete` or `deferred`, and non-blank `execute.md`. - `VerificationStatus` (:58-64; impl :142-250). `ErrFlowStateMissing` tolerated here (result.Verification stays zero-valued). Read-only in-memory `reconcileExpiredAttempts` (:154-156; expiry rule `attemptExpired` :467-479 — running attempts expire immediately when OwnerPID is dead, else when now−max(started,heartbeat) > 2h). - Review stage (:158-212): status/verdict/digests from persisted `ReviewStageState`; FreshnessReasons from `PrepareReview` findings ("governed review inputs…"), fingerprint mismatch (only under `strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness`, currently false), missing `review.md`, digest mismatch vs recorded `ArtifactDigest`, and `ValidateReviewContent` against the recorded fingerprint (validation manifest pinned to recorded fingerprint while the strict switch is off, :191-196). `Fresh = no reasons ∧ LastComplete != nil`. Resume counters/resumability computed from `Resume.Coverage`; resumability invalidated by prepare failures or manifest fingerprint/model drift. - Smoke stage (:213-247): inherits "review evidence is not current" when review not fresh; checks `smoke.md` existence, digest equality vs `ArtifactDigest`, `ValidateSmokeContent`, and input-fingerprint presence; snapshot refresh of external evidence only under `strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness` (off). - `deriveAssessment` (:252-285) precedence: malformed ⇒ blocked; fresh review fail ⇒ fail ("diagnostic smoke cannot change this result"); fresh review blocked ⇒ blocked; incomplete chain ⇒ incomplete naming earliest non-current stage (review before smoke); then smoke verdict mapping fail/blocked/not_applicable/pass_with_findings/pass; review pass_with_findings downgrades a clean pass; unsupported smoke verdict ⇒ blocked. - Currentness decision (:65): `statusErr == nil ∧ status.Review.Fresh ∧ ExecutionStatus=="completed" ∧ !req.Review.Restart`. - Not current ⇒ runs `s.Review` (:66-77) with the request's review sub-request (dry-run forced to match). Continuation exception `allowDiagnosticContinuation = To==smoke ∧ review.Status==completed ∧ Verdict==fail ∧ Smoke.ForceReview ∧ Smoke.OverrideConfirmed ∧ rationale non-empty` (:74); any other review error aborts. (Review returns error `"review completed with failing verdict"` exactly for completed-fail, review.go:640-642; blocked/prerequisite/restart-focus errors do not qualify.) - `To==review || DryRun` ⇒ refresh VerificationStatus (non-dry-run only; its error is discarded, :83) and return. - Else smoke continuation (:87-94): `RunSmoke(req.Smoke)`; final VerificationStatus refresh (error discarded, :93); returns the smoke error. ### 2.3 Flow delegation (`internal/sprint/flow.go`) - Dry-run `flow --to review|smoke` delegates to `Verify{DryRun:true}` with message from the review prompt preview (:97-105). - Non-dry-run `flow --to review|smoke` materializes planning stages 1..execute (`flowStages` end=8 for review/smoke targets, :278-280), then calls `Verify{To:req.To}` carrying Review/Smoke sub-requests (:178-182); result message `verification assessment=%s next=%s`. ### 2.4 Web/TUI - Operation kinds `verify-start`/`verify-dry-run` (operations.go:92-93); dry-run executes read-only via `ss.Verify(..., DryRun:true)` (operations.go:507-512); start goes through the durable operation runner with progress events (operation_runner.go:97-113), constructing the same VerifyRequest including `OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview`. Web start requires the two-phase prepare→confirmation-token handshake (web/security.go preparation store; operation_handlers.go prepare/start handlers). ### 2.5 `internal/sprint/verification_phase.go` Small adapter layer: `VerificationPhase` enum {conformance-review, qa, repair}; `ParseVerificationPhase` accepts "review" as an alias for conformance-review; `CompatibilityStage` maps only conformance-review → StageReview so QA/repair can never enter planning order. ### 2.6 `internal/sprint/freshness_policy.go` Three compile-time switches (`strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness`, `strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness`, `strictSmokeAuthorProtectedSnapshots`) all currently `false`, with an in-file rationale: snapshot-based invalidation was too brittle (unrelated/concurrent/tiny edits); artifact existence, format, recorded-digest checks, and authoring allowlists remain enforced. This is the documented meaning of "fresh" today. ## 3. Inputs / outputs Inputs: project/sprint refs; workspace tree (`.run-state.json`, `execute.md`, `review.md`, `smoke.md`, `flow-state.json`, `project-index.md` harness catalog, governed protocol docs consumed by PrepareReview); wall clock `s.now()`; `os.Getpid()`; request flags (To, DryRun, Restart, Focus, level/suite/test selection, timeout, ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed, OverrideRationale, NonInteractive). Outputs: `VerifyResult{project, sprint, to, dry_run, review_result?, smoke_result?, verification}` where VerificationStatus carries per-stage execution/verdict/fresh/freshness-reasons/digests/fingerprints/attempts/override plus overall assessment+next action (domain.go:187-228). Side effects are entirely delegated: review writes (atomic `review.md` replace, flow-state Review record incl. attempt lifecycle/resume/heartbeats, publications), smoke writes (harness authoring inside declared paths, discovery+run subprocesses, atomic `smoke.md` replace, flow-state Smoke record + LastComplete + DiagnosticOverride, roadmap delivery mark, smoke-stage publication). CLI adds structured JSON/text rendering, exit codes, and durable run-control records/events. ## 4. Authoritative state - Canonical gate state: `projects/

/sprints//flow-state.json` `Review`/`Smoke` blocks — Status, Verdict, Fingerprint (governed-input), ArtifactDigest (content sha256), InputFingerprint, LastComplete completions, ActiveAttempt/LastAttempt, Stale, SmokeFingerprint, Override block (Requested/Confirmed/Rationale/RequestedAt/ReviewFingerprint/ReviewVerdict, domain.go:178-185). Ownership and write grammar belong to `sprint-flow-state`; this surface is the policy reader that decides which writes happen (via delegated Review/RunSmoke). - Execute authority checked pre-transition: `.run-state.json` (+ legacy raw-summary fallback) and `execute.md` — owned by the execute surface. - Run-control DB (CLI/web non-dry-run): durable operation acceptance/claim/fence/events/terminal outcome for the verify invocation itself. - No third verification artifact exists or is created by this surface (contract requirement). ## 5. Invariants (as implemented) - Execute completeness precedes everything; incomplete evidence short-circuits before any review/smoke work. - Transition target ∈ {review, smoke}, default smoke; validated at parse and service layers. - Canonical review evidence reused only when Fresh∧completed∧not-restarted; otherwise review reruns (with resume/focus semantics owned by the review surface). - Both ends re-verify at decision time: Verify recomputes freshness from current bytes; the smoke gate independently reloads flow state, recomputes staleness, compares digests, validates content, then applies the verdict ladder (smoke_protocol.go:177-209). - Override ladder: stale reviews cannot be overridden at all (:195-196); fail/blocked verdicts require ForceReview ∧ OverrideConfirmed ∧ non-empty rationale at BOTH Verify's continuation check and the smoke gate; CLI additionally requires `--force-review`⇒`--override-reason` at parse time. - Diagnostics cannot become canonical: force-review marks the smoke result DiagnosticOnly (:128); DiagnosticOnly results return before `commitSmoke` (:180-182) so no smoke.md/state/roadmap/publication occurs; narrow selections are diagnostic (test always, smoke_protocol.go:520; suite/level unless discovery proves complete coverage, :496/:508); `deriveAssessment` never reads Override (pinned by TestDiagnosticOverrideCannotPromoteCanonicalSmoke). - Overall assessment is a pure deterministic function of the two stage states + malformed flag; malformed canonical evidence forces blocked regardless of verdicts. - Expired running attempts are reconciled read-only inside VerificationStatus; persisted transitions are owned by explicit operations (pinned by test). - Single mutation lease spans the whole transition (review + smoke share it via context marker); concurrent mutators get typed `ErrVerificationConflict`. ## 6. Trust boundaries - flow-state.json Review/Smoke blocks are trusted gate input for promotion decisions; controls are load-time strict validation (flow-state surface) plus decision-time recomputation here (digest equality, content validators, governed-input manifests). Anyone able to rewrite flow state or review.md/smoke.md can alter gate inputs; digest/content binding narrows what passes. - Override flags originate from CLI args / web request fields; they authorize running smoke despite a failing review and persist an attributable audit record (rationale + review fingerprint/verdict + timestamp into smoke.md and the flow-state Override block). Confirmation is enforced per-surface: CLI `--yes`, web two-phase confirmation token. - Harness identity/executable/CWD/evidence paths come from `project-index.md` + manifest and are containment-checked (canonicalDirectory* ) by the smoke surface before any process runs; Verify itself launches no processes. - Fingerprinting helpers hash files and (under disabled switches / review snapshot path) walk the target repo (`targetIdentity` bounded at 64 MiB/file, symlink-escape rejected; `targetRevisionIdentity` used by review.go:288 deliberately excludes unrelated dirty files). - Error/diagnostic text crossing into durable state is sanitized downstream (`safeError` redaction/truncation) per the flow-state pack. ## 7. External effects & lifecycle semantics - Effects: reviewer runtime sessions (delegated Review), external harness subprocesses with bounded timeouts (delegated smoke), atomic artifact replaces, flow-state saves, git publications for review/smoke stages, roadmap.md delivery mark on canonical pass only (smoke.go:39-48), post-review session deletion (review.go:643-645), run-control operation records/events. - Cancellation: non-dry-run CLI/web run under the durable operation context; `controlOperation` acknowledges requested cancellations and heartbeats ownership; review persists explicit cancelled state via `persistReviewFailure`; smoke classifies timeout/cancelled/cleanup-incomplete harness outcomes into typed smokeErrors and terminal attempt statuses (`AttemptCancelled/TimedOut/Blocked/Failed`, smoke.go:234-250). - Interruption residue: running attempts left behind are expired by dead-PID-or-2h rule in read-side reconcile; the persisted transition belongs to ReconcileInterruptedMutation / the next writer (flow-state surface). - Retry/restart: rerunning verify after a failed review reruns review (resume coverage retained unless `--restart-review`; restart also bypasses currentness reuse at :65); smoke rerun reconciles its own attempt records and re-gates. - Error propagation: first blocking error wins; VerificationStatus refresh errors are intentionally discarded on the two return legs (:83, :93); ErrFlowStateMissing tolerated at entry; CLI always emits a single JSON document on failure with a structured `error` field (pinned by TestSprintFailureJSONIsOneStructuredDocument) and exits 5 on fail/blocked assessment even without a run error. - Long-held lease: the single lease covers potentially hours of reviewer/harness runtime; cross-process contention waits or fails fast with conflict diagnostics naming the owner PID/AcquiredAt. ## 8. Immediate surface dependencies - `sprint-conformance-review`: `PrepareReview` (manifests/findings/fingerprints feeding freshness), `Service.Review` (execution + saveReviewState completion records), resume/focus plan. - `sprint-smoke-gate`: `RunSmoke`/`runSmoke`, `prepareSmokeStatic` review gate, `selectSmoke` diagnostic classification, `commitSmoke` canonical-vs-diagnostic commit boundary, publication rules. - `sprint-flow-state`: LoadFlowState/SaveFlowState grammar, attempt validators, reconcile helpers (`attemptExpired`/`reconcileExpiredAttempts` physically live in verify.go:467-510 but are documented as flow-state machinery shared with locks.go). - Execute surface: `.run-state.json`/`execute.md` authority behind requireCompleteExecute; `ExecuteComplete` also serves flow's execute-validity check (flow.go:308). - Run-control/durable operations: CLI/web acceptance boundary, fencing, events, cancellation. - Publication seam (`publishReviewStage`/`publishSmokeStage`), roadmap project domain (`MarkRoadmapSprintDelivered`). ## 9. Contracts (CURRENT-CONTRACT evidence) - PRD.md:585-586: "`ultraplan sprint verify [--to review|smoke]` — Convenience orchestration over the same review and smoke use cases; it does not introduce a third verification artifact." - TRD.md:2016 command list; :2020-2030 flow options include "explicit smoke level/suite/test selection, smoke timeout, and review-failure diagnostic override" and "stable --json output for review, smoke, verify, and status"; Phase 3 adds review then smoke as valid `--to` stages. - roadmap.md:1002: verify as convenience command over the same use cases; :1010 acceptance: "`flow --to smoke` and `verify` always apply review before smoke unless the user explicitly selects a diagnostic override"; :1011 stale-marking on governed-input/implementation change; :1012 narrow-test pass must not hide containing-suite failure; :1014 "overall assessment is deterministic and cannot contradict the stage verdicts." - In-repo help text (sprint_commands.go:1647-1655, 1723-1728): gate order, override semantics ("requires --yes and a rationale, remains diagnostic, and cannot improve the overall assessment"), and flow/verify parity are user-facing contract statements pinned by TestVerifyHelpExplainsGateAndRecovery. - Workspace skills (skills.go:187/226/371-386, mirrored in workspace skill docs): instruct invoking agents NOT to use verify/flow/smoke commands to perform stage work — usage-policy context, not code behavior. - HISTORY: freshness_policy.go comment documents why snapshot strictness is off (brittleness attribution) — deliberate temporary posture. ## 10. Tests (evidence map) Package-internal (internal/sprint/verify_test.go): - TestDeriveAssessmentPrecedence (:30-60): 12-case table pinning the full assessment precedence incl. override-carrying pass still reduced by fresh review fail? (override case asserts fail dominates). - TestDiagnosticOverrideCannotPromoteCanonicalSmoke (:209-222): deriveAssessment ignores a confirmed override. - TestVerificationStatusDerivesExpiredReviewAttemptWithoutWriting (:123-153): 25h-old running attempt reported failed/timed_out in-memory; durable bytes untouched. - TestVerificationStatusImmediatelyRecoversDeadAttemptOwner (:155-178): dead OwnerPID expires instantly. - TestReviewFreshnessArtifactEditAndFocusedMerge (:180-207): appended external edit flips Fresh=false and assessment incomplete. - TestVerificationMutationConflictIsTyped (:224-241): concurrent review ⇒ ErrVerificationConflict. - Migration/pre-code-context tests (:62-121) cover flow-state loading strata this surface reads. Related: smoke_test.go selection diagnostic pins (:70, :200-208 — test always diagnostic; suite/level diagnostic unless complete); reviewFixture (review_test.go:678-697) builds complete-execute fixtures including the legacy `.run-state.json` summary shape. App-level: sprint_verify_commands_test.go (:11-37 parse/validation matrix incl. flow parity, :39-46 help contract); sprint_commands_test.go:120-147 verify --json failure emits one structured doc with `error` present. Baseline: full `go test ./...` green at frozen commit (review/baseline). 40: 	if !req.DryRun {
41: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
42: 		if lockErr != nil {
43: 			return VerifyResult{}, lockErr
44: 		}
45: 		defer release()
46: 		ctx = lockedCtx
47: 	}
48: 	if req.To == "" {
49: 		req.To = StageSmoke
50: 	}
51: 	if req.To != StageReview && req.To != StageSmoke {
52: 		return VerifyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("verify target must be review or smoke")
53: 	}
54: 	result := VerifyResult{Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun}
55: 	if err := s.requireCompleteExecute(projectRef, sprintRef); err != nil {
56: 		return result, err
57: 	}
58: 	status, statusErr := s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
59: 	if statusErr != nil && !errors.Is(statusErr, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
60: 		return result, statusErr
61: 	}
62: 	if statusErr == nil {
63: 		result.Verification = status
64: 	}
65: 	currentReview := statusErr == nil && status.Review.Fresh && status.Review.ExecutionStatus == string(ReviewCompleted) && !req.Review.Restart
66: 	if !currentReview {
67: 		if req.Progress != nil {
68: 			req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageReview, State: "running", Message: "obtaining current review evidence"})
69: 		}
70: 		reviewReq := req.Review
71: 		reviewReq.DryRun = req.DryRun
72: 		review, err := s.Review(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, reviewReq)
73: 		result.ReviewResult = &review
74: 		allowDiagnosticContinuation := req.To == StageSmoke && review.Status == ReviewCompleted && review.Verdict == ReviewFail && req.Smoke.ForceReview && req.Smoke.OverrideConfirmed && strings.TrimSpace(req.Smoke.OverrideRationale) != ""
75: 		if err != nil && !allowDiagnosticContinuation {
76: 			return result, err
77: 		}
78: 	} else if req.Progress != nil {
79: 		req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageReview, State: "skipped", Message: "current review evidence is acceptable"})
80: 	}
81: 	if req.To == StageReview || req.DryRun {
82: 		if !req.DryRun {
83: 			result.Verification, _ = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
84: 		}
85: 		return result, nil
86: 	}
87: 	if req.Progress != nil {
88: 		req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageSmoke, State: "running", Message: "evaluating review gate and running smoke"})
89: 	}
90: 	smokeReq := req.Smoke
91: 	smoke, err := s.RunSmoke(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, smokeReq)
92: 	result.SmokeResult = &smoke
93: 	result.Verification, _ = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
94: 	return result, err
95: }

142: func (s Service) VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef string) (VerificationStatus, error) {
143: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
144: 	if err != nil {
145: 		return VerificationStatus{}, err
146: 	}
147: 	out := VerificationStatus{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug}
148: 	out.Review = VerificationStage{Stage: StageReview, ExecutionStatus: "missing", Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview), NextAction: "Run review."}
149: 	out.Smoke = VerificationStage{Stage: StageSmoke, ExecutionStatus: "missing", Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), NextAction: "Run smoke after a current acceptable review."}
150: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
151: 	if err != nil {
152: 		return out, err
153: 	}
154: 	// Status derives expired-attempt truth without mutating durable state.
155: 	// The next explicit review/smoke operation owns any persisted transition.
156: 	reconcileExpiredAttempts(&state, s.now().UTC())
157: 	malformed := false
158: 	if state.Review != nil {
159: 		r := state.Review
160: 		out.Review.ExecutionStatus, out.Review.Verdict = string(r.Status), string(r.Verdict)
161: 		out.Review.InputFingerprint, out.Review.ArtifactDigest = r.Fingerprint, r.ArtifactDigest
162: 		out.Review.ActiveAttempt, out.Review.LastAttempt = r.ActiveAttempt, r.LastAttempt
163: 		if r.Resume != nil {
164: 			out.Review.Total = len(r.Resume.Coverage)
165: 			for _, checkpoint := range r.Resume.Coverage {
166: 				if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted {
167: 					out.Review.Completed++
168: 				}
169: 				if checkpoint.SessionID != "" && checkpoint.Status != AttemptCompleted {
170: 					out.Review.RetainedSessions++
171: 				}
172: 			}
173: 			out.Review.Resumable = out.Review.Completed > 0
174: 		}
175: 		manifest, findings, prepareErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
176: 		if prepareErr != nil || len(findings) > 0 {
177: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "governed review inputs are unavailable or invalid")
178: 		} else if strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness && manifest.Fingerprint != r.Fingerprint {
179: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review input fingerprint changed")
180: 		}
181: 		if r.Resume != nil && (prepareErr != nil || len(findings) > 0 || manifest.Fingerprint != r.Resume.InputFingerprint || manifest.Model != r.Resume.Model) {
182: 			out.Review.Resumable = false
183: 		}
184: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(mustArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview))
185: 		if readErr != nil {
186: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact is missing")
187: 		} else {
188: 			if r.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes(data) != r.ArtifactDigest {
189: 				out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact digest changed")
190: 			}
191: 			validationManifest := manifest
192: 			if !strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness {
193: 				// Validate the canonical artifact against the fingerprint recorded when
194: 				// it completed, rather than a later filesystem snapshot.
195: 				validationManifest.Fingerprint = r.Fingerprint
196: 			}
197: 			if prepareErr == nil && len(findings) == 0 && len(ValidateReviewContent(string(data), validationManifest)) > 0 {
198: 				malformed = true
199: 				out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact is malformed")
200: 			}
201: 		}
202: 		out.Review.Fresh = len(out.Review.FreshnessReasons) == 0 && r.LastComplete != nil
203: 		if !out.Review.Fresh {
204: 			if out.Review.Resumable {
205: 				out.Review.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("Resume review from %d/%d validated coverage (%d retained sessions), or restart it explicitly.", out.Review.Completed, out.Review.Total, out.Review.RetainedSessions)
206: 			} else {
207: 				out.Review.NextAction = "Rerun review using the current governed inputs."
208: 			}
209: 		} else {
210: 			out.Review.NextAction = "Review is current."
211: 		}
212: 	}
213: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
214: 		sm := state.Smoke
215: 		out.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, out.Smoke.Verdict = string(sm.Status), string(sm.Verdict)
216: 		out.Smoke.InputFingerprint, out.Smoke.ArtifactDigest, out.Smoke.RunID = sm.InputFingerprint, sm.ArtifactDigest, sm.RunID
217: 		out.Smoke.Issues, out.Smoke.Evidence, out.Smoke.Override = append([]SmokeIssue(nil), sm.Issues...), append([]EvidenceReference(nil), sm.Evidence...), sm.Override
218: 		out.Smoke.ActiveAttempt, out.Smoke.LastAttempt = sm.ActiveAttempt, sm.LastAttempt
219: 		if !out.Review.Fresh {
220: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "review evidence is not current")
221: 		}
222: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(mustArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageSmoke))
223: 		if readErr != nil {
224: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact is missing")
225: 		} else {
226: 			if sm.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes(data) != sm.ArtifactDigest {
227: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact digest changed")
228: 			}
229: 			if len(ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))) > 0 {
230: 				malformed = true
231: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact is malformed")
232: 			}
233: 		}
234: 		if sm.LastComplete == nil || sm.InputFingerprint == "" {
235: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke input fingerprint is unavailable")
236: 		} else if strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness {
237: 			if fingerprint, identityErr := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(sm.LastComplete.Evidence); identityErr != nil || fingerprint != sm.InputFingerprint {
238: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke inputs or external evidence changed")
239: 			}
240: 		}
241: 		out.Smoke.Fresh = len(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons) == 0
242: 		if !out.Smoke.Fresh {
243: 			out.Smoke.NextAction = "Rerun the required containing smoke suite."
244: 		} else {
245: 			out.Smoke.NextAction = "Smoke evidence is current."
246: 		}
247: 	}
248: 	out.Assessment, out.NextAction = deriveAssessment(out.Review, out.Smoke, malformed)
249: 	return out, nil
250: }

252: func deriveAssessment(review, smoke VerificationStage, malformed bool) (OverallAssessment, string) {
253: 	if malformed {
254: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Repair or regenerate malformed canonical verification evidence."
255: 	}
256: 	if review.Fresh && review.Verdict == string(ReviewFail) {
257: 		return AssessmentFail, "Resolve review findings and rerun review; diagnostic smoke cannot change this result."
258: 	}
259: 	if review.Fresh && review.Verdict == string(ReviewVerdictBlocked) {
260: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Satisfy the review prerequisite and rerun review."
261: 	}
262: 	if !review.Fresh || review.ExecutionStatus != string(ReviewCompleted) || !smoke.Fresh || smoke.ExecutionStatus != string(SmokeCompleted) {
263: 		if !review.Fresh || review.ExecutionStatus != string(ReviewCompleted) {
264: 			return AssessmentIncomplete, "Run or retry review, the earliest non-current verification stage."
265: 		}
266: 		return AssessmentIncomplete, "Run or retry smoke, the earliest non-current verification stage."
267: 	}
268: 	switch SmokeVerdict(smoke.Verdict) {
269: 	case SmokeFailVerdict:
270: 		return AssessmentFail, "Resolve the classified failure and rerun the required containing suite."
271: 	case SmokeBlockedVerdict:
272: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Restore smoke prerequisites, coverage, or evidence and rerun smoke."
273: 	case SmokeNotApplicable:
274: 		return AssessmentNotApplicable, "No runtime smoke is applicable; retain the current review rationale."
275: 	case SmokePassWithOpenIssues:
276: 		return AssessmentPassWithFindings, "Resolve linked relevant issues and rerun narrow plus containing scope."
277: 	case SmokePass:
278: 		if ReviewVerdict(review.Verdict) == ReviewPassWithFindings {
279: 			return AssessmentPassWithFindings, "Address review findings if a clean assessment is required."
280: 		}
281: 		return AssessmentPass, "No verification action required."
282: 	default:
283: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Repair the unsupported smoke verdict."
284: 	}
285: }

302: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "timeout", Digest: result.EffectiveTimeout.String() + ":" + result.TimeoutSource},
303: 	}
304: 	if strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness {
305: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "target", Path: p.Target})
306: 	}
307: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
308: 		path := evidence.Path
309: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
310: 			path = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(path))

312: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "file", Path: path})

314: 	for _, issue := range result.Issues {
315: 		path := issue.Path
316: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {

319: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "file", Path: path}, EvidenceReference{Kind: "fact", Path: "issue:" + issue.ID, Digest: issue.Status})

321: 	sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool {
322: 		if refs[i].Path == refs[j].Path {

325: 		return refs[i].Path < refs[j].Path
326: 	})

330: func refreshEvidenceFingerprint(refs []EvidenceReference) (string, error) {
331: 	h := sha256.New()
332: 	for _, ref := range refs {
333: 		digest := ref.Digest
334: 		var err error
335: 		switch ref.Kind {
336: 		case "file":
337: 			digest, err = hashFile(ref.Path)
338: 		case "target":
339: 			digest, err = targetIdentity(ref.Path)
340: 		}
341: 		if err != nil {
342: 			return "", err
343: 		}
344: 		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%s\x00%s\n", ref.Kind, filepath.ToSlash(ref.Path), digest)
345: 	}
346: 	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
347: }

349: func targetIdentity(root string) (string, error) {
350: 	root, err := filepath.Abs(root)
351: 	if err != nil {
352: 		return "", err
353: 	}
354: 	rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
355: 	if err != nil {
356: 		return "", err
357: 	}
358: 	if rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
359: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("target root must not be a symlink")
360: 	}
361: 	paths := []string{}
362: 	head := "non-git"
363: 	gitRootOK := false
364: 	if output, gitErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").Output(); gitErr == nil {
365: 		gitRoot, absErr := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
366: 		gitRootOK = absErr == nil && filepath.Clean(gitRoot) == filepath.Clean(root)
367: 	}
368: 	if output, gitErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").Output(); gitErr == nil && gitRootOK {
369: 		head = strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
370: 		if output, listErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z").Output(); listErr == nil {
371: 			for _, value := range strings.Split(string(output), "\x00") {
372: 				if value != "" {
373: 					paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(value)))
374: 				}
375: 			}
376: 		}
377: 	}
378: 	if len(paths) == 0 {
379: 		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
380: 			if walkErr != nil {
381: 				return walkErr
382: 			}
383: 			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
384: 			if relErr != nil {
385: 				return relErr
386: 			}
387: 			if entry.IsDir() && entry.Name() == ".git" {
388: 				return filepath.SkipDir
389: 			}
390: 			if rel == "." || entry.IsDir() {
391: 				return nil
392: 			}
393: 			paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
394: 			return nil
395: 		})
396: 		if err != nil {
397: 			return "", err
398: 		}
399: 	}
400: 	sort.Strings(paths)
401: 	h := sha256.New()
402: 	fmt.Fprintf(h, "root=%s\nhead=%s\n", filepath.ToSlash(root), head)
403: 	for _, rel := range paths {
404: 		full := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
405: 		info, statErr := os.Lstat(full)
406: 		if errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
407: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00missing\n", rel)
408: 			continue
409: 		}
410: 		if statErr != nil {
411: 			return "", statErr
412: 		}
413: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
414: 			linkValue, linkErr := os.Readlink(full)
415: 			if linkErr != nil {
416: 				return "", linkErr
417: 			}
418: 			target, linkErr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(full)
419: 			if linkErr != nil || !inside(root, target) {
420: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("target symlink escapes or is unreadable: %s", rel)
421: 			}
422: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00symlink=%s\n", rel, filepath.ToSlash(linkValue))
423: 			info, statErr = os.Stat(target)
424: 			if statErr != nil {
425: 				return "", statErr
426: 			}
427: 			full = target
428: 		}
429: 		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
430: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00non-regular\n", rel)
431: 			continue
432: 		}
433: 		if info.Size() > 64<<20 {
434: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("target file exceeds bounded identity read: %s", rel)
435: 		}
436: 		digest, readErr := hashFile(full)
437: 		if readErr != nil {
438: 			return "", readErr
439: 		}
440: 		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%s\n", rel, digest)
441: 	}
442: 	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
443: }

445: // targetRevisionIdentity deliberately excludes unrelated dirty files. Review
446: // separately freezes every execute-reported changed path, so repository-wide
447: // hashing would make an unrelated edit invalidate an otherwise atomic review.
448: func targetRevisionIdentity(root string) (string, error) {

452: 	}

455: 		gitRoot, absErr := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))

467: func attemptExpired(attempt *VerificationAttempt, now time.Time) bool {
468: 	if attempt == nil || attempt.Status != AttemptRunning {
469: 		return false
470: 	}
471: 	if attempt.OwnerPID > 0 && !verificationProcessAlive(attempt.OwnerPID) {
472: 		return true
473: 	}
474: 	lastSeen := attempt.StartedAt
475: 	if attempt.HeartbeatAt.After(lastSeen) {
476: 		lastSeen = attempt.HeartbeatAt
477: 	}
478: 	return now.Sub(lastSeen) > 2*time.Hour
479: }

481: func reconcileExpiredAttempts(state *FlowState, now time.Time) bool {
482: 	changed := false
483: 	if state.Review != nil && attemptExpired(state.Review.ActiveAttempt, now) {
484: 		attempt := *state.Review.ActiveAttempt
485: 		attempt.Status = AttemptTimedOut
486: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
487: 		attempt.Category = "interrupted"
488: 		attempt.Diagnostics = []string{"review attempt expired without a terminal update"}
489: 		attempt.NextAction = "Resume the retained review coverage, or restart review explicitly."
490: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt = nil
491: 		state.Review.LastAttempt = &attempt
492: 		state.Review.Status = ReviewFailed
493: 		state.Review.LastRunAt = &now
494: 		changed = true
495: 	}
496: 	if state.Smoke != nil && attemptExpired(state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt, now) {
497: 		attempt := *state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
498: 		attempt.Status = AttemptTimedOut
499: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
500: 		attempt.Category = "interrupted"
501: 		attempt.Diagnostics = []string{"smoke attempt expired without a terminal update"}
502: 		attempt.NextAction = "Confirm no harness process remains, then rerun smoke."
503: 		state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt = nil
504: 		state.Smoke.LastAttempt = &attempt
505: 		state.Smoke.Status = SmokeFailed
506: 		state.Smoke.LastRunAt = &now
507: 		changed = true
508: 	}
509: 	return changed
510: }

37: // Verify is the sole review-to-smoke transition. It requires complete execute
38: // evidence, reuses current canonical review evidence, and applies the smoke gate.
39: func (s Service) Verify(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req VerifyRequest) (VerifyResult, error) {
40: 	if !req.DryRun {
41: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
42: 		if lockErr != nil {
43: 			return VerifyResult{}, lockErr
44: 		}
45: 		defer release()
46: 		ctx = lockedCtx
47: 	}
48: 	if req.To == "" {
49: 		req.To = StageSmoke
50: 	}
51: 	if req.To != StageReview && req.To != StageSmoke {
52: 		return VerifyResult{}, fmt.Errorf("verify target must be review or smoke")
53: 	}
54: 	result := VerifyResult{Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, To: req.To, DryRun: req.DryRun}
55: 	if err := s.requireCompleteExecute(projectRef, sprintRef); err != nil {
56: 		return result, err
57: 	}
58: 	status, statusErr := s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
59: 	if statusErr != nil && !errors.Is(statusErr, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
60: 		return result, statusErr
61: 	}
62: 	if statusErr == nil {
63: 		result.Verification = status
64: 	}
65: 	currentReview := statusErr == nil && status.Review.Fresh && status.Review.ExecutionStatus == string(ReviewCompleted) && !req.Review.Restart
66: 	if !currentReview {
67: 		if req.Progress != nil {
68: 			req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageReview, State: "running", Message: "obtaining current review evidence"})
69: 		}
70: 		reviewReq := req.Review
71: 		reviewReq.DryRun = req.DryRun
72: 		review, err := s.Review(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, reviewReq)
73: 		result.ReviewResult = &review
74: 		allowDiagnosticContinuation := req.To == StageSmoke && review.Status == ReviewCompleted && review.Verdict == ReviewFail && req.Smoke.ForceReview && req.Smoke.OverrideConfirmed && strings.TrimSpace(req.Smoke.OverrideRationale) != ""
75: 		if err != nil && !allowDiagnosticContinuation {
76: 			return result, err
77: 		}
78: 	} else if req.Progress != nil {
79: 		req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageReview, State: "skipped", Message: "current review evidence is acceptable"})
80: 	}
81: 	if req.To == StageReview || req.DryRun {
82: 		if !req.DryRun {
83: 			result.Verification, _ = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
84: 		}
85: 		return result, nil
86: 	}
87: 	if req.Progress != nil {
88: 		req.Progress(FlowProgress{Stage: StageSmoke, State: "running", Message: "evaluating review gate and running smoke"})
89: 	}
90: 	smokeReq := req.Smoke
91: 	smoke, err := s.RunSmoke(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, smokeReq)
92: 	result.SmokeResult = &smoke
93: 	result.Verification, _ = s.VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
94: 	return result, err
95: }

97: func (s Service) requireCompleteExecute(projectRef, sprintRef string) error {
98: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
99: 	if err != nil {
100: 		return err
101: 	}
102: 	state, err := LoadExecuteRunState(s.root, sp)
103: 	if err != nil {
104: 		path, pathErr := ExecuteRunStatePath(s.root, sp)
105: 		if pathErr == nil {
106: 			var summary struct {
107: 				Status string   `json:"status"`
108: 				Files  []string `json:"files"`
109: 			}
110: 			if data, readErr := os.ReadFile(path); readErr == nil && json.Unmarshal(data, &summary) == nil && (summary.Status == "complete" || summary.Status == "completed") && len(summary.Files) > 0 {
111: 				content, artifactErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageExecute)
112: 				if artifactErr == nil && strings.TrimSpace(content) != "" {
113: 					return nil
114: 				}
115: 			}
116: 		}
117: 		return fmt.Errorf("execute evidence is incomplete: %w", err)
118: 	}
119: 	if len(state.Tasks) == 0 {
120: 		return fmt.Errorf("execute evidence is incomplete: no planned tasks")
121: 	}
122: 	for _, task := range state.Tasks {
123: 		if task.Status != ExecuteTaskComplete && task.Status != ExecuteTaskDeferred {
124: 			return fmt.Errorf("execute evidence is incomplete: task %q is %s", task.Identity.Name, task.Status)
125: 		}
126: 	}
127: 	data, err := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageExecute)
128: 	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(data) == "" {
129: 		return fmt.Errorf("execute evidence is incomplete: execute.md is missing")
130: 	}
131: 	return nil
132: }

142: func (s Service) VerificationStatus(projectRef, sprintRef string) (VerificationStatus, error) {
143: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
144: 	if err != nil {
145: 		return VerificationStatus{}, err
146: 	}
147: 	out := VerificationStatus{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug}
148: 	out.Review = VerificationStage{Stage: StageReview, ExecutionStatus: "missing", Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview), NextAction: "Run review."}
149: 	out.Smoke = VerificationStage{Stage: StageSmoke, ExecutionStatus: "missing", Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), NextAction: "Run smoke after a current acceptable review."}
150: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
151: 	if err != nil {
152: 		return out, err
153: 	}
154: 	// Status derives expired-attempt truth without mutating durable state.
155: 	// The next explicit review/smoke operation owns any persisted transition.
156: 	reconcileExpiredAttempts(&state, s.now().UTC())
157: 	malformed := false
158: 	if state.Review != nil {
159: 		r := state.Review
160: 		out.Review.ExecutionStatus, out.Review.Verdict = string(r.Status), string(r.Verdict)
161: 		out.Review.InputFingerprint, out.Review.ArtifactDigest = r.Fingerprint, r.ArtifactDigest
162: 		out.Review.ActiveAttempt, out.Review.LastAttempt = r.ActiveAttempt, r.LastAttempt
163: 		if r.Resume != nil {
164: 			out.Review.Total = len(r.Resume.Coverage)
165: 			for _, checkpoint := range r.Resume.Coverage {
166: 				if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted {
167: 					out.Review.Completed++
168: 				}
169: 				if checkpoint.SessionID != "" && checkpoint.Status != AttemptCompleted {
170: 					out.Review.RetainedSessions++
171: 				}
172: 			}
173: 			out.Review.Resumable = out.Review.Completed > 0
174: 		}
175: 		manifest, findings, prepareErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
176: 		if prepareErr != nil || len(findings) > 0 {
177: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "governed review inputs are unavailable or invalid")
178: 		} else if strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness && manifest.Fingerprint != r.Fingerprint {
179: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review input fingerprint changed")
180: 		}
181: 		if r.Resume != nil && (prepareErr != nil || len(findings) > 0 || manifest.Fingerprint != r.Resume.InputFingerprint || manifest.Model != r.Resume.Model) {
182: 			out.Review.Resumable = false
183: 		}
184: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(mustArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview))
185: 		if readErr != nil {
186: 			out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact is missing")
187: 		} else {
188: 			if r.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes(data) != r.ArtifactDigest {
189: 				out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact digest changed")
190: 			}
191: 			validationManifest := manifest
192: 			if !strictCompletedReviewSnapshotFreshness {
193: 				// Validate the canonical artifact against the fingerprint recorded when
194: 				// it completed, rather than a later filesystem snapshot.
195: 				validationManifest.Fingerprint = r.Fingerprint
196: 			}
197: 			if prepareErr == nil && len(findings) == 0 && len(ValidateReviewContent(string(data), validationManifest)) > 0 {
198: 				malformed = true
199: 				out.Review.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Review.FreshnessReasons, "review artifact is malformed")
200: 			}
201: 		}
202: 		out.Review.Fresh = len(out.Review.FreshnessReasons) == 0 && r.LastComplete != nil
203: 		if !out.Review.Fresh {
204: 			if out.Review.Resumable {
205: 				out.Review.NextAction = fmt.Sprintf("Resume review from %d/%d validated coverage (%d retained sessions), or restart it explicitly.", out.Review.Completed, out.Review.Total, out.Review.RetainedSessions)
206: 			} else {
207: 				out.Review.NextAction = "Rerun review using the current governed inputs."
208: 			}
209: 		} else {
210: 			out.Review.NextAction = "Review is current."
211: 		}
212: 	}
213: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
214: 		sm := state.Smoke
215: 		out.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, out.Smoke.Verdict = string(sm.Status), string(sm.Verdict)
216: 		out.Smoke.InputFingerprint, out.Smoke.ArtifactDigest, out.Smoke.RunID = sm.InputFingerprint, sm.ArtifactDigest, sm.RunID
217: 		out.Smoke.Issues, out.Smoke.Evidence, out.Smoke.Override = append([]SmokeIssue(nil), sm.Issues...), append([]EvidenceReference(nil), sm.Evidence...), sm.Override
218: 		out.Smoke.ActiveAttempt, out.Smoke.LastAttempt = sm.ActiveAttempt, sm.LastAttempt
219: 		if !out.Review.Fresh {
220: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "review evidence is not current")
221: 		}
222: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(mustArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageSmoke))
223: 		if readErr != nil {
224: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact is missing")
225: 		} else {
226: 			if sm.ArtifactDigest == "" || hashBytes(data) != sm.ArtifactDigest {
227: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact digest changed")
228: 			}
229: 			if len(ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))) > 0 {
230: 				malformed = true
231: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke artifact is malformed")
232: 			}
233: 		}
234: 		if sm.LastComplete == nil || sm.InputFingerprint == "" {
235: 			out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke input fingerprint is unavailable")
236: 		} else if strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness {
237: 			if fingerprint, identityErr := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(sm.LastComplete.Evidence); identityErr != nil || fingerprint != sm.InputFingerprint {
238: 				out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons = append(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons, "smoke inputs or external evidence changed")
239: 			}
240: 		}
241: 		out.Smoke.Fresh = len(out.Smoke.FreshnessReasons) == 0
242: 		if !out.Smoke.Fresh {
243: 			out.Smoke.NextAction = "Rerun the required containing smoke suite."
244: 		} else {
245: 			out.Smoke.NextAction = "Smoke evidence is current."
246: 		}
247: 	}
248: 	out.Assessment, out.NextAction = deriveAssessment(out.Review, out.Smoke, malformed)
249: 	return out, nil
250: }

252: func deriveAssessment(review, smoke VerificationStage, malformed bool) (OverallAssessment, string) {
253: 	if malformed {
254: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Repair or regenerate malformed canonical verification evidence."
255: 	}
256: 	if review.Fresh && review.Verdict == string(ReviewFail) {
257: 		return AssessmentFail, "Resolve review findings and rerun review; diagnostic smoke cannot change this result."
258: 	}
259: 	if review.Fresh && review.Verdict == string(ReviewVerdictBlocked) {
260: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Satisfy the review prerequisite and rerun review."
261: 	}
262: 	if !review.Fresh || review.ExecutionStatus != string(ReviewCompleted) || !smoke.Fresh || smoke.ExecutionStatus != string(SmokeCompleted) {
263: 		if !review.Fresh || review.ExecutionStatus != string(ReviewCompleted) {
264: 			return AssessmentIncomplete, "Run or retry review, the earliest non-current verification stage."
265: 		}
266: 		return AssessmentIncomplete, "Run or retry smoke, the earliest non-current verification stage."
267: 	}
268: 	switch SmokeVerdict(smoke.Verdict) {
269: 	case SmokeFailVerdict:
270: 		return AssessmentFail, "Resolve the classified failure and rerun the required containing suite."
271: 	case SmokeBlockedVerdict:
272: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Restore smoke prerequisites, coverage, or evidence and rerun smoke."
273: 	case SmokeNotApplicable:
274: 		return AssessmentNotApplicable, "No runtime smoke is applicable; retain the current review rationale."
275: 	case SmokePassWithOpenIssues:
276: 		return AssessmentPassWithFindings, "Resolve linked relevant issues and rerun narrow plus containing scope."
277: 	case SmokePass:
278: 		if ReviewVerdict(review.Verdict) == ReviewPassWithFindings {
279: 			return AssessmentPassWithFindings, "Address review findings if a clean assessment is required."
280: 		}
281: 		return AssessmentPass, "No verification action required."
282: 	default:
283: 		return AssessmentBlocked, "Repair the unsupported smoke verdict."
284: 	}
285: }

293: func smokeIdentityReferences(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) []EvidenceReference {
294: 	refs := []EvidenceReference{
295: 		{Kind: "file", Path: p.ManifestPath},
296: 		{Kind: "file", Path: filepath.Join(p.Sprint.Path, "review.md")},
297: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "review-fingerprint", Digest: result.ReviewFingerprint},
298: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "review-verdict", Digest: string(result.ReviewVerdict)},
299: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "scope", Digest: result.ScopeKind + ":" + result.Scope},
300: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "harness", Digest: result.Harness + ":" + result.Protocol},
301: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "prerequisites", Digest: strings.Join(result.Prerequisites, "\x00")},
302: 		{Kind: "fact", Path: "timeout", Digest: result.EffectiveTimeout.String() + ":" + result.TimeoutSource},
303: 	}
304: 	if strictCompletedSmokeSnapshotFreshness {
305: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "target", Path: p.Target})
306: 	}
307: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
308: 		path := evidence.Path
309: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
310: 			path = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(path))
311: 		}
312: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "file", Path: path})
313: 	}
314: 	for _, issue := range result.Issues {
315: 		path := issue.Path
316: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
317: 			path = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(path))
318: 		}
319: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: "file", Path: path}, EvidenceReference{Kind: "fact", Path: "issue:" + issue.ID, Digest: issue.Status})
320: 	}
321: 	sort.Slice(refs, func(i, j int) bool {
322: 		if refs[i].Path == refs[j].Path {
323: 			return refs[i].Kind < refs[j].Kind
324: 		}
325: 		return refs[i].Path < refs[j].Path
326: 	})
327: 	return refs
328: }

330: func refreshEvidenceFingerprint(refs []EvidenceReference) (string, error) {
331: 	h := sha256.New()
332: 	for _, ref := range refs {
333: 		digest := ref.Digest
334: 		var err error
335: 		switch ref.Kind {
336: 		case "file":
337: 			digest, err = hashFile(ref.Path)
338: 		case "target":
339: 			digest, err = targetIdentity(ref.Path)
340: 		}
341: 		if err != nil {
342: 			return "", err
343: 		}
344: 		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%s\x00%s\n", ref.Kind, filepath.ToSlash(ref.Path), digest)
345: 	}
346: 	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
347: }

349: func targetIdentity(root string) (string, error) {
350: 	root, err := filepath.Abs(root)
351: 	if err != nil {
352: 		return "", err
353: 	}
354: 	rootInfo, err := os.Lstat(root)
355: 	if err != nil {
356: 		return "", err
357: 	}
358: 	if rootInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
359: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("target root must not be a symlink")
360: 	}
361: 	paths := []string{}
362: 	head := "non-git"
363: 	gitRootOK := false
364: 	if output, gitErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").Output(); gitErr == nil {
365: 		gitRoot, absErr := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
366: 		gitRootOK = absErr == nil && filepath.Clean(gitRoot) == filepath.Clean(root)
367: 	}
368: 	if output, gitErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").Output(); gitErr == nil && gitRootOK {
369: 		head = strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
370: 		if output, listErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z").Output(); listErr == nil {
371: 			for _, value := range strings.Split(string(output), "\x00") {
372: 				if value != "" {
373: 					paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(value)))
374: 				}
375: 			}
376: 		}
377: 	}
378: 	if len(paths) == 0 {
379: 		err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
380: 			if walkErr != nil {
381: 				return walkErr
382: 			}
383: 			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
384: 			if relErr != nil {
385: 				return relErr
386: 			}
387: 			if entry.IsDir() && entry.Name() == ".git" {
388: 				return filepath.SkipDir
389: 			}
390: 			if rel == "." || entry.IsDir() {
391: 				return nil
392: 			}
393: 			paths = append(paths, filepath.ToSlash(rel))
394: 			return nil
395: 		})
396: 		if err != nil {
397: 			return "", err
398: 		}
399: 	}
400: 	sort.Strings(paths)
401: 	h := sha256.New()
402: 	fmt.Fprintf(h, "root=%s\nhead=%s\n", filepath.ToSlash(root), head)
403: 	for _, rel := range paths {
404: 		full := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
405: 		info, statErr := os.Lstat(full)
406: 		if errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
407: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00missing\n", rel)
408: 			continue
409: 		}
410: 		if statErr != nil {
411: 			return "", statErr
412: 		}
413: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
414: 			linkValue, linkErr := os.Readlink(full)
415: 			if linkErr != nil {
416: 				return "", linkErr
417: 			}
418: 			target, linkErr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(full)
419: 			if linkErr != nil || !inside(root, target) {
420: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("target symlink escapes or is unreadable: %s", rel)
421: 			}
422: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00symlink=%s\n", rel, filepath.ToSlash(linkValue))
423: 			info, statErr = os.Stat(target)
424: 			if statErr != nil {
425: 				return "", statErr
426: 			}
427: 			full = target
428: 		}
429: 		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
430: 			fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00non-regular\n", rel)
431: 			continue
432: 		}
433: 		if info.Size() > 64<<20 {
434: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("target file exceeds bounded identity read: %s", rel)
435: 		}
436: 		digest, readErr := hashFile(full)
437: 		if readErr != nil {
438: 			return "", readErr
439: 		}
440: 		fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%s\n", rel, digest)
441: 	}
442: 	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
443: }

445: // targetRevisionIdentity deliberately excludes unrelated dirty files. Review
446: // separately freezes every execute-reported changed path, so repository-wide
447: // hashing would make an unrelated edit invalidate an otherwise atomic review.
448: func targetRevisionIdentity(root string) (string, error) {
449: 	root, err := filepath.Abs(root)
450: 	if err != nil {
451: 		return "", err
452: 	}
453: 	head := "non-git"
454: 	if output, gitErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").Output(); gitErr == nil {
455: 		gitRoot, absErr := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)))
456: 		if absErr == nil && filepath.Clean(gitRoot) == filepath.Clean(root) {
457: 			if output, headErr := exec.Command("git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").Output(); headErr == nil {
458: 				head = strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
459: 			}
460: 		}
461: 	}
462: 	h := sha256.New()
463: 	fmt.Fprintf(h, "root=%s\nhead=%s\n", filepath.ToSlash(root), head)
464: 	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
465: }

467: func attemptExpired(attempt *VerificationAttempt, now time.Time) bool {
468: 	if attempt == nil || attempt.Status != AttemptRunning {
469: 		return false
470: 	}
471: 	if attempt.OwnerPID > 0 && !verificationProcessAlive(attempt.OwnerPID) {
472: 		return true
473: 	}
474: 	lastSeen := attempt.StartedAt
475: 	if attempt.HeartbeatAt.After(lastSeen) {
476: 		lastSeen = attempt.HeartbeatAt
477: 	}
478: 	return now.Sub(lastSeen) > 2*time.Hour
479: }

481: func reconcileExpiredAttempts(state *FlowState, now time.Time) bool {
482: 	changed := false
483: 	if state.Review != nil && attemptExpired(state.Review.ActiveAttempt, now) {
484: 		attempt := *state.Review.ActiveAttempt
485: 		attempt.Status = AttemptTimedOut
486: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
487: 		attempt.Category = "interrupted"
488: 		attempt.Diagnostics = []string{"review attempt expired without a terminal update"}
489: 		attempt.NextAction = "Resume the retained review coverage, or restart review explicitly."
490: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt = nil

296: 		identity, identityErr := targetRevisionIdentity(target.Path)
297: 		if identityErr != nil {
298: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", "target identity", "target/.identity", "target identity unavailable", identityErr.Error(), "Restore a contained readable target tree."))
299: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: "missing"})
300: 		} else {
301: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: identity})
302: 		}
303: 	}
304: 	resolve := func(selected SelectedItem, section project.CatalogSection, kind, prefix string, reviewer bool) {
305: 		entry, ok := catalogEntry(catalog, section, selected)
306: 		if !ok {
307: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, selected.Path, "catalog entry unresolved", "selected entry is not uniquely resolvable", "Fix project-index.md or sprint-index.md."))
308: 			return
309: 		}
310: 		path := entry.Path
311: 		full, pathErr := workspace.ResolveInside(s.root, path)
312: 		if pathErr != nil {
313: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unsafe catalog path", pathErr.Error(), "Use a contained workspace path."))
314: 			return
315: 		}
316: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
317: 		if readErr != nil {
318: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name), Kind: kind, Name: selected.Name, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
319: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unreadable catalog entry", readErr.Error(), "Restore the selected catalog file."))
320: 			return
321: 		}
322: 		id := prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name)
323: 		in := reviewInput(id, kind, selected.Name, path, string(data))
324: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, in)
325: 		if reviewer {
326: 			manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, in)
327: 		}
328: 		manifest.Contents[path] = string(data)
329: 	}
330: 	for _, selected := range idx.Contracts {
331: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionActiveContractPool, "contract", "contract", true)
332: 	}
333: 	for _, selected := range idx.ReviewProtocols {
334: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionReviewProtocols, "protocol", "protocol", false)
335: 	}
336: 	if unresolvedExecutePlanTasks(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], runContent, planManifest) {
337: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "tasks", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan), "plan tasks are not resolved", "one or more unchecked top-level tasks lack an explicit deferred run-state outcome", "Complete each executable task or defer it with an explicit rationale before review."))
338: 	}
339: 	// The handbook receives an independent reviewer even though it is also a governed input.
340: 	if handbook := findReviewInput(manifest.Inputs, "technical-handbook"); handbook.Path != "" {
341: 		handbook.ID, handbook.Kind, handbook.Name = "handbook", "handbook", "Technical Handbook"
342: 		manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, handbook)
343: 	}
344: 	if strings.TrimSpace(manifest.Model) == "" || manifest.Model == "unresolved" {
345: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Configuration", "review model", "", "missing review model", "no review, plan, or runtime model is configured", "Set planning.review_model or planning.plan_model."))
346: 	}
347: 	for _, command := range reviewVerificationCommands(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)]) {
348: 		if !strings.Contains(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute)], command) {
349: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Verification Evidence", command, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute), "approved verification evidence missing", "execute.md does not record the planned command", "Run the approved command and record its result in execute.md."))
350: 		}
351: 	}
352: 	if runContent != "" && reviewRunStateIncomplete([]byte(runContent)) {
353: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "run-state", runPath, "execute is incomplete", "run state contains non-complete tasks or status", "Complete or safely resolve execute before review."))
354: 	}
355: 	if len(manifest.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
356: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = []string{"(execute evidence did not enumerate changed paths)"}
357: 	} else {
358: 		for _, changed := range manifest.ChangedPaths {
359: 			full := changed
360: 			if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
361: 				full = filepath.Join(manifest.Target, filepath.FromSlash(changed))
362: 			}
363: 			if !inside(manifest.Target, full) {
364: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed path escapes target", "path is outside the approved implementation target", "Use contained execute evidence."))
365: 				continue
366: 			}
367: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
368: 			if readErr != nil {
369: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed target input unreadable", readErr.Error(), "Restore the changed path or correct execute evidence."))
370: 				continue
371: 			}
372: 			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(manifest.Target, full)
373: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("target-"+slugReviewID(rel), "target", rel, "target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel), string(data)))
374: 			manifest.Contents["target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
375: 		}
376: 	}
377: 	if patch, available, patchErr := buildReviewPatch(sp, manifest.Target, manifest.ChangedPaths); patchErr != nil {
378: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", "implementation diff", reviewPatchPath, "cannot create baseline-to-sprint review patch", patchErr.Error(), "Restore the sprint worktree and its recorded baseline before review."))
379: 	} else if available {
380: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("implementation-diff", "implementation-diff", "baseline-to-sprint patch", reviewPatchPath, patch))
381: 		manifest.Contents[reviewPatchPath] = patch
382: 	}
383: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Coverage[i].ID < manifest.Coverage[j].ID })
384: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Inputs, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Inputs[i].Path < manifest.Inputs[j].Path })
385: 	manifest.Fingerprint = fingerprintReviewManifest(manifest)
386: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
387: 	return manifest, findings, nil
388: }

418: func (s Service) Review(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewResult, error) {
419: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
420: 	result := ReviewResult{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, DryRun: req.DryRun, Fingerprint: m.Fingerprint, Artifact: reviewArtifact(m), Status: ReviewReady, Focused: append([]string(nil), req.Focus...)}
421: 	if err != nil {
422: 		return result, err
423: 	}
424: 	if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
425: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
426: 		if lockErr != nil {
427: 			return result, lockErr
428: 		}
429: 		defer release()
430: 		ctx = lockedCtx
431: 	}
432: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
433: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
434: 		for _, f := range findings {
435: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "preflight", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, f.Problem+": "+f.Cause)})
436: 		}
437: 		if !req.DryRun {
438: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
439: 				return result, errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation"), saveErr)
440: 			}
441: 		}
442: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
443: 	}
444: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return result, err
447: 	}
448: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(ctx, sp, inputs, true)
449: 	if err != nil {
450: 		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
451: 			result.Status = ReviewCancelled
452: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())})
453: 			if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
454: 				return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), err)
455: 			}
456: 		}
457: 		return result, err
458: 	}
459: 	result.Prompt, err = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, renderReviewPreview(m))
460: 	if err != nil {
461: 		return result, err
462: 	}
463: 	if req.DryRun || req.PromptOnly {
464: 		result.Message = "review dry run"
465: 		return result, nil
466: 	}
467: 	if s.runtime == nil {
468: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for review")
469: 	}
470: 	if req.Restart && len(req.Focus) > 0 {
471: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("--restart cannot be combined with focused review")
472: 	}
473: 	result.Status = ReviewRunning
474: 	result.Restarted = req.Restart
475: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); err != nil {
476: 		return result, err
477: 	}
478: 	runCoverage, coverage, focusErr := s.reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Focus)
479: 	if focusErr != nil {
480: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
481: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "focus", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, focusErr.Error())})
482: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), focusErr)
483: 	}
484: 	resumeSessions := map[string]string{}
485: 	completed := 0
486: 	if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
487: 		resume, rebased, resumeErr := s.initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Restart)
488: 		if resumeErr != nil {
489: 			result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
490: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-state", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, resumeErr.Error())})
491: 			return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), resumeErr)
492: 		}
493: 		runCoverage, coverage, resumeSessions, completed = reviewResumePlan(s.root, m, resume)
494: 		result.Resumed = !req.Restart && (completed > 0 || len(resumeSessions) > 0)
495: 		result.Reused = completed
496: 		if rebased > 0 {
497: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-rebased", Message: fmt.Sprintf("reused %d validated reviewer result(s) from the prior input fingerprint; incomplete coverage uses the current snapshot", rebased)})
498: 		}
499: 	}
500: 	reviewerRoot, snapshotErr := prepareReviewSnapshot(m)
501: 	if snapshotErr != nil {
502: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
503: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "snapshot", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, snapshotErr.Error())})
504: 		if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
505: 			return result, errors.Join(snapshotErr, saveErr)
506: 		}
507: 		return result, snapshotErr
508: 	}
509: 	m.ReviewerRoot = reviewerRoot
510: 	workers := m.Concurrency
511: 	if workers > len(runCoverage) {
512: 		workers = len(runCoverage)
513: 	}
514: 	if workers < 1 {
515: 		workers = 1
516: 	}
517: 	type item struct {
518: 		index     int
519: 		value     ReviewCoverageResult
520: 		sessionID string
521: 	}
522: 	type sessionItem struct {
523: 		coverageID string
524: 		sessionID  string
525: 	}
526: 	jobs := make(chan int)
527: 	done := make(chan item, len(runCoverage))
528: 	sessions := make(chan sessionItem, max(1, len(runCoverage)*4))
529: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
530: 	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
531: 		wg.Add(1)
532: 		go func() {
533: 			defer wg.Done()
534: 			for i := range jobs {
535: 				c := runCoverage[i]
536: 				sessionID := resumeSessions[c.ID]
537: 				lastSessionID := sessionID
538: 				value, finalSessionID := s.runReviewer(ctx, m, c, sessionID, func(id string) {
539: 					if id != "" && id != lastSessionID {
540: 						lastSessionID = id
541: 						sessions <- sessionItem{coverageID: c.ID, sessionID: id}
542: 					}
543: 				})
544: 				done <- item{index: i, value: value, sessionID: finalSessionID}
545: 			}
546: 		}()
547: 	}
548: 	go func() {
549: 		for i := range runCoverage {
550: 			jobs <- i
551: 		}
552: 		close(jobs)
553: 		wg.Wait()
554: 		close(sessions)
555: 		close(done)
556: 	}()
557: 	var progressSaveErr error
558: 	completedSessionIDs := map[string]bool{}
559: 	for done != nil || sessions != nil {
560: 		select {
561: 		case session, ok := <-sessions:
562: 			if !ok {
563: 				sessions = nil
564: 				continue
565: 			}
566: 			if session.sessionID != "" && len(req.Focus) == 0 {
567: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, session.coverageID, session.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
568: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		case got, ok := <-done:
572: 			if !ok {
573: 				done = nil
574: 				continue
575: 			}
576: 			if got.value.Error == "" && !reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, got.value) {
577: 				got.value.Error = "reviewer result failed schema or citation validation"
578: 			}
579: 			for i := range m.Coverage {
580: 				if m.Coverage[i].ID == got.value.CoverageID {
581: 					coverage[i] = got.value
582: 					break
583: 				}
584: 			}
585: 			completed++
586: 			if got.sessionID != "" {
587: 				completedSessionIDs[got.sessionID] = true
588: 			}
589: 			if req.Progress != nil {
590: 				req.Progress(ReviewProgress{Completed: completed, Total: len(coverage), CoverageID: got.value.CoverageID, Message: "reviewer complete"})
591: 			}
592: 			result.Coverage = coverage
593: 			if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
594: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, got.value, got.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
595: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
596: 				}
597: 			}
598: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); saveErr != nil {
599: 				progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
600: 			}
601: 		}
602: 	}
603: 	result.Coverage = coverage
604: 	validatedFindings, validationDiagnostics, validatedVerdict := validateReviewCoverage(s.root, m, coverage)
605: 	result.Findings = validatedFindings
606: 	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, validationDiagnostics...)
607: 	result.Verdict = validatedVerdict
608: 	if progressSaveErr != nil {
609: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
610: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "state-write-failed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, progressSaveErr.Error())})
611: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), progressSaveErr)
612: 	}
613: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
614: 		result.Status = ReviewCancelled
615: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: ctx.Err().Error()})
616: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), ctx.Err())
617: 	}
618: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewVerdictBlocked {
619: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
620: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("review failed to produce complete valid coverage"))
621: 	}
622: 	current, currentFindings, currentErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
623: 	if currentErr != nil || len(currentFindings) > 0 || current.Fingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
624: 		for _, message := range reviewManifestChanges(m, current, currentFindings, currentErr) {
625: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "inputs-changed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, message)})
626: 		}
627: 	}
628: 	result.Status = ReviewCompleted
629: 	content := RenderReviewMarkdown(m, result)
630: 	if vf := ValidateReviewContent(content, m); len(vf) > 0 {
631: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
632: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "artifact-invalid", Message: vf[0].Problem})
633: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("generated review.md failed validation"))
634: 	}
635: 	path, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview)
636: 	if err := atomicWriteReview(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
637: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
638: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "write-failed", Message: safeError(err)})
639: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), err)
640: 	}
641: 	now := s.now().UTC()
642: 	result.Message = "review complete"
643: 	result.Artifact = ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
644: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); err != nil {
645: 		return result, err
646: 	}
647: 	publications, publishErr := s.publishReviewStage(ctx, sp)
648: 	result.Publications = append(result.Publications, publications...)
649: 	if publishErr != nil {
650: 		return result, publishErr
651: 	}
652: 	_ = os.RemoveAll(reviewerRoot)
653: 	_ = now
654: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewFail {
655: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review completed with failing verdict")
656: 	}
657: 	for sessionID := range completedSessionIDs {
658: 		_ = s.deleteCompletedSession(ctx, sessionID)
659: 	}
660: 	return result, nil
661: }

665: 		return result, errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal review state: %w", saveErr))
666: 	}
667: 	return result, cause

670: func (s Service) reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, focus []string) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, error) {
671: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
672: 	if len(focus) == 0 {
673: 		return m.Coverage, coverage, nil
674: 	}
675: 	wanted := map[string]bool{}
676: 	for _, raw := range focus {
677: 		for _, id := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
678: 			id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
679: 			if id != "" {
680: 				wanted[id] = true
681: 			}
682: 		}
683: 	}
684: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(m.SprintRoot))})
685: 	if err != nil || state.Review == nil || state.Review.LastComplete == nil {
686: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires a previous complete review with retained coverage")
687: 	}
688: 	previous := state.Review.LastComplete
689: 	if previous.InputFingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
690: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review cannot retain coverage from a different input fingerprint")
691: 	}
692: 	retained := map[string]ReviewCoverageResult{}
693: 	for _, item := range previous.Coverage {
694: 		retained[item.CoverageID] = item
695: 	}
696: 	var run []ReviewInput
697: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
698: 		if wanted[item.ID] {
699: 			run = append(run, item)
700: 			delete(wanted, item.ID)
701: 			continue
702: 		}
703: 		prior, ok := retained[item.ID]
704: 		if !ok || prior.Error != "" {
705: 			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review lacks valid retained coverage %q", item.ID)
706: 		}
707: 		coverage[i] = prior
708: 	}
709: 	if len(wanted) > 0 {
710: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review names unknown coverage")
711: 	}
712: 	if len(run) == 0 {
713: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires at least one coverage id")
714: 	}
715: 	return run, coverage, nil
716: }

718: func (s Service) initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, restart bool) (ReviewResumeState, int, error) {
719: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
720: 	if err != nil {
721: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
722: 	}
723: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
724: 	if err != nil {
725: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
726: 	}
727: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.ActiveAttempt == nil {
728: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, fmt.Errorf("review attempt state is unavailable")
729: 	}
730: 	current := state.Review.Resume
731: 	rebased := 0
732: 	if restart || !reviewResumeCompatible(current, m) {
733: 		checkpoints := make([]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, 0, len(m.Coverage))
734: 		now := s.now().UTC()
735: 		prior := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
736: 		if !restart && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(current, m) {
737: 			for _, checkpoint := range current.Coverage {
738: 				prior[checkpoint.CoverageID] = checkpoint
739: 			}
740: 		}
741: 		for _, item := range m.Coverage {
742: 			checkpoint := ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{CoverageID: item.ID, Status: AttemptPending, UpdatedAt: now}
743: 			if previous, ok := prior[item.ID]; ok && previous.Status == AttemptCompleted && previous.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, *previous.Result) {
744: 				checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
745: 				checkpoint.Result = previous.Result
746: 				rebased++
