169: func (s Service) PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewManifest, []ValidationFinding, error) {
170: 	sp, inputs, catalog, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
171: 	if err != nil {
172: 		return ReviewManifest{}, nil, err
173: 	}
174: 	manifest := ReviewManifest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, SprintRoot: workspace.Rel(s.root, sp.Path), Target: "", WorkspaceRoot: s.root, Contents: map[string]string{}}
175: 	manifest.Concurrency = req.Concurrency
176: 	if manifest.Concurrency <= 0 {
177: 		manifest.Concurrency = s.reviewConcurrency
178: 	}
179: 	if manifest.Concurrency <= 0 {
180: 		manifest.Concurrency = 3
181: 	}
182: 	if manifest.Concurrency > 16 {
183: 		manifest.Concurrency = 16
184: 	}
185: 	selection := s.reviewModelSelection(req.ModelOverride)
186: 	manifest.Model, manifest.ModelSource = selection.Model, selection.Source
187: 	if rt, ok := s.verificationRuntime[VerificationPhaseConformanceReview]; ok {
188: 		manifest.Variant = rt.Variant
189: 	} else if rt, ok := s.stageRuntime[StagePlan]; ok {
190: 		manifest.Variant = rt.Variant
191: 	}
192: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
193: 	var assetErr error
194: 	manifest.PromptTemplate, assetErr = loadReviewAsset(s.root, "prompts/review.md", []string{"Automated Sprint Review"})
195: 	if assetErr != nil {
196: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review assets", "prompts/review.md", "prompts/review.md", "invalid review prompt override", assetErr.Error(), "Remove or correct the intentional override."))
197: 	}
198: 	manifest.OutputTemplate, assetErr = loadReviewAsset(s.root, "templates/review.md", []string{"Review Context", "Final Assessment"})
199: 	if assetErr != nil {
200: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review assets", "templates/review.md", "templates/review.md", "invalid review template override", assetErr.Error(), "Remove or correct the intentional override."))
201: 	}
202: 	if manifest.PromptTemplate != "" {
203: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("review-prompt", "asset", "review prompt", "prompts/review.md", manifest.PromptTemplate))
204: 		manifest.Contents["prompts/review.md"] = manifest.PromptTemplate
205: 	}
206: 	if manifest.OutputTemplate != "" {
207: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("review-template", "asset", "review template", "templates/review.md", manifest.OutputTemplate))
208: 		manifest.Contents["templates/review.md"] = manifest.OutputTemplate
209: 	}
210: 	idx, indexFindings := ValidateSprintIndexContent(inputs.SprintIndex, catalog)
211: 	findings = append(findings, indexFindings...)
212: 	target, targetFindings := s.resolveSprintTarget(sp, inputs.ProjectIndex, false)
213: 	findings = append(findings, targetFindings...)
214: 	manifest.Target = target.Path
215: 	base := []struct {
216: 		id, kind string
217: 		stage    PlanningStage
218: 	}{
219: 		{"requirements", "governed", StageRequirements}, {"code-context", "governed", StageCodeContext}, {"sprint-index", "governed", StageSprintIndex},
220: 		{"technical-handbook", "handbook", StageTechnicalHandbook}, {"reasoning", "governed", StageReasoning},
221: 		{"plan", "governed", StagePlan}, {"execute", "governed", StageExecute},
222: 	}
223: 	projectRoot := filepath.Join(s.root, "projects", sp.Project)
224: 	projectInputs := []struct{ id, path string }{{"project-index", filepath.Join(projectRoot, "project-index.md")}, {"roadmap", filepath.Join(projectRoot, "roadmap.md")}}
225: 	for _, doc := range inputs.Docs {
226: 		projectInputs = append(projectInputs, struct{ id, path string }{"doc-" + slugReviewID(doc), filepath.Join(projectRoot, filepath.FromSlash(doc))})
227: 	}
228: 	for _, item := range projectInputs {
229: 		rel := workspace.Rel(s.root, item.path)
230: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(item.path)
231: 		if readErr != nil {
232: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: item.id, Kind: "governed", Name: item.id, Path: rel, Hash: "missing"})
233: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", item.id, rel, "missing governed project input", safeError(readErr), "Restore the governed project input."))
234: 			continue
235: 		}
236: 		content := string(data)
237: 		if item.id == "project-index" {
238: 			content = reviewRelevantProjectIndexContent(content)
239: 		} else if item.id == "roadmap" {
240: 			content = reviewRelevantRoadmapContent(content)
241: 		}
242: 		manifest.Contents[rel] = content
243: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput(item.id, "governed", item.id, rel, content))
244: 	}
245: 	for _, item := range base {
246: 		data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, item.stage)
247: 		path := ArtifactRelPath(sp, item.stage)
248: 		if readErr != nil || strings.TrimSpace(data) == "" {
249: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: item.id, Kind: item.kind, Name: item.id, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
250: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", item.id, path, "missing review input", safeError(readErr), "Complete execute and all governed sprint artifacts before review."))
251: 			continue
252: 		}
253: 		manifest.Contents[path] = data
254: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput(item.id, item.kind, item.id, path, data))
255: 	}
256: 	areaDir, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageAreaReasoning)
257: 	if entries, readErr := os.ReadDir(areaDir); readErr == nil {
258: 		for _, entry := range entries {
259: 			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(entry.Name()), ".md") {
260: 				continue
261: 			}
262: 			full := filepath.Join(areaDir, entry.Name())
263: 			data, fileErr := os.ReadFile(full)
264: 			rel := workspace.Rel(s.root, full)
265: 			if fileErr != nil {
266: 				manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "area-" + slugReviewID(entry.Name()), Kind: "governed", Name: entry.Name(), Path: rel, Hash: "missing"})
267: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", entry.Name(), rel, "missing area reasoning input", safeError(fileErr), "Restore selected area reasoning."))
268: 				continue
269: 			}
270: 			manifest.Contents[rel] = string(data)
271: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("area-"+slugReviewID(entry.Name()), "governed", entry.Name(), rel, string(data)))
272: 		}
273: 	}
274: 	planManifest, planFindings := s.planManifest(sp, inputs, catalog)
275: 	findings = append(findings, planFindings...)
276: 	if len(planFindings) == 0 {
277: 		findings = append(findings, ValidatePlanContent(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], planManifest)...)
278: 	}
279: 	runPath := ExecuteRunStateRelPath(sp)
280: 	var runContent string
281: 	if data, readErr := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(runPath))); readErr == nil {
282: 		runContent = string(data)
283: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = excludeGovernedReviewPaths(reviewChangedPaths(data), manifest.Inputs)
284: 		handoff, handoffErr := executionHandoffContent(data, manifest.ChangedPaths)
285: 		if handoffErr != nil {
286: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review prerequisites", "execution handoff", runPath, "execute run state cannot be summarized", handoffErr.Error(), "Repair the execute run state before review."))
287: 		} else {
288: 			path := executionHandoffPath(sp)
289: 			manifest.Contents[path] = handoff
290: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("execution-handoff", "execution", "execution handoff", path, handoff))
291: 		}
292: 	} else {
293: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "execution-handoff", Kind: "execution", Name: "execution handoff", Path: executionHandoffPath(sp), Hash: "missing"})
294: 	}
295: 	if target.Path != "" {
296: 		identity, identityErr := targetRevisionIdentity(target.Path)
297: 		if identityErr != nil {
298: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", "target identity", "target/.identity", "target identity unavailable", identityErr.Error(), "Restore a contained readable target tree."))
299: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: "missing"})
300: 		} else {
301: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: "target-identity", Kind: "target", Name: "target identity", Path: "target/.identity", Hash: identity})
302: 		}
303: 	}
304: 	resolve := func(selected SelectedItem, section project.CatalogSection, kind, prefix string, reviewer bool) {
305: 		entry, ok := catalogEntry(catalog, section, selected)
306: 		if !ok {
307: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, selected.Path, "catalog entry unresolved", "selected entry is not uniquely resolvable", "Fix project-index.md or sprint-index.md."))
308: 			return
309: 		}
310: 		path := entry.Path
311: 		full, pathErr := workspace.ResolveInside(s.root, path)
312: 		if pathErr != nil {
313: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unsafe catalog path", pathErr.Error(), "Use a contained workspace path."))
314: 			return
315: 		}
316: 		data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
317: 		if readErr != nil {
318: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, ReviewInput{ID: prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name), Kind: kind, Name: selected.Name, Path: path, Hash: "missing"})
319: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Review manifest", selected.Name, path, "unreadable catalog entry", readErr.Error(), "Restore the selected catalog file."))
320: 			return
321: 		}
322: 		id := prefix + "-" + slugReviewID(selected.Name)
323: 		in := reviewInput(id, kind, selected.Name, path, string(data))
324: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, in)
325: 		if reviewer {
326: 			manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, in)
327: 		}
328: 		manifest.Contents[path] = string(data)
329: 	}
330: 	for _, selected := range idx.Contracts {
331: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionActiveContractPool, "contract", "contract", true)
332: 	}
333: 	for _, selected := range idx.ReviewProtocols {
334: 		resolve(selected, project.SectionReviewProtocols, "protocol", "protocol", false)
335: 	}
336: 	if unresolvedExecutePlanTasks(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)], runContent, planManifest) {
337: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "tasks", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan), "plan tasks are not resolved", "one or more unchecked top-level tasks lack an explicit deferred run-state outcome", "Complete each executable task or defer it with an explicit rationale before review."))
338: 	}
339: 	// The handbook receives an independent reviewer even though it is also a governed input.
340: 	if handbook := findReviewInput(manifest.Inputs, "technical-handbook"); handbook.Path != "" {
341: 		handbook.ID, handbook.Kind, handbook.Name = "handbook", "handbook", "Technical Handbook"
342: 		manifest.Coverage = append(manifest.Coverage, handbook)
343: 	}
344: 	if strings.TrimSpace(manifest.Model) == "" || manifest.Model == "unresolved" {
345: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Configuration", "review model", "", "missing review model", "no review, plan, or runtime model is configured", "Set planning.review_model or planning.plan_model."))
346: 	}
347: 	for _, command := range reviewVerificationCommands(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StagePlan)]) {
348: 		if !strings.Contains(manifest.Contents[ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute)], command) {
349: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Verification Evidence", command, ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageExecute), "approved verification evidence missing", "execute.md does not record the planned command", "Run the approved command and record its result in execute.md."))
350: 		}
351: 	}
352: 	if runContent != "" && reviewRunStateIncomplete([]byte(runContent)) {
353: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Plan Execution", "run-state", runPath, "execute is incomplete", "run state contains non-complete tasks or status", "Complete or safely resolve execute before review."))
354: 	}
355: 	if len(manifest.ChangedPaths) == 0 {
356: 		manifest.ChangedPaths = []string{"(execute evidence did not enumerate changed paths)"}
357: 	} else {
358: 		for _, changed := range manifest.ChangedPaths {
359: 			full := changed
360: 			if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
361: 				full = filepath.Join(manifest.Target, filepath.FromSlash(changed))
362: 			}
363: 			if !inside(manifest.Target, full) {
364: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed path escapes target", "path is outside the approved implementation target", "Use contained execute evidence."))
365: 				continue
366: 			}
367: 			data, readErr := os.ReadFile(full)
368: 			if readErr != nil {
369: 				findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", changed, changed, "changed target input unreadable", readErr.Error(), "Restore the changed path or correct execute evidence."))
370: 				continue
371: 			}
372: 			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(manifest.Target, full)
373: 			manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("target-"+slugReviewID(rel), "target", rel, "target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel), string(data)))
374: 			manifest.Contents["target/"+filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(data)
375: 		}
376: 	}
377: 	if patch, available, patchErr := buildReviewPatch(sp, manifest.Target, manifest.ChangedPaths); patchErr != nil {
378: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Review target", "implementation diff", reviewPatchPath, "cannot create baseline-to-sprint review patch", patchErr.Error(), "Restore the sprint worktree and its recorded baseline before review."))
379: 	} else if available {
380: 		manifest.Inputs = append(manifest.Inputs, reviewInput("implementation-diff", "implementation-diff", "baseline-to-sprint patch", reviewPatchPath, patch))
381: 		manifest.Contents[reviewPatchPath] = patch
382: 	}
383: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Coverage, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Coverage[i].ID < manifest.Coverage[j].ID })
384: 	sort.Slice(manifest.Inputs, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Inputs[i].Path < manifest.Inputs[j].Path })
385: 	manifest.Fingerprint = fingerprintReviewManifest(manifest)
386: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
387: 	return manifest, findings, nil
388: }

390: func (s Service) PromptReview(projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (PromptPreview, error) {
391: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
392: 	if err != nil {
393: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
394: 	}
395: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
396: 		return PromptPreview{}, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
397: 	}
398: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
399: 	if err != nil {
400: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
401: 	}
402: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(context.Background(), sp, inputs, false)
403: 	if err != nil {
404: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
405: 	}
406: 	stagePrompt := renderReviewPreview(m)
407: 	if len(m.Coverage) > 0 {
408: 		stagePrompt = renderReviewerPrompt(m, m.Coverage[0])
409: 	}
410: 	prompt, err := composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, stagePrompt)
411: 	if err != nil {
412: 		return PromptPreview{}, err
413: 	}
414: 	explanation := explainComposedPrompt(prompt)
415: 	return PromptPreview{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, Prompt: prompt, Explanation: &explanation}, nil
416: }

418: func (s Service) Review(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req ReviewRequest) (ReviewResult, error) {
419: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
420: 	result := ReviewResult{Project: m.Project, Sprint: m.Sprint, DryRun: req.DryRun, Fingerprint: m.Fingerprint, Artifact: reviewArtifact(m), Status: ReviewReady, Focused: append([]string(nil), req.Focus...)}
421: 	if err != nil {
422: 		return result, err
423: 	}
424: 	if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
425: 		lockedCtx, release, lockErr := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
426: 		if lockErr != nil {
427: 			return result, lockErr
428: 		}
429: 		defer release()
430: 		ctx = lockedCtx
431: 	}
432: 	if len(findings) > 0 {
433: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
434: 		for _, f := range findings {
435: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "preflight", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, f.Problem+": "+f.Cause)})
436: 		}
437: 		if !req.DryRun {
438: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
439: 				return result, errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation"), saveErr)
440: 			}
441: 		}
442: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review prerequisites failed validation")
443: 	}
444: 	sp, inputs, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return result, err
447: 	}
448: 	m.SharedPrefix, err = s.prepareSharedPromptContext(ctx, sp, inputs, true)
449: 	if err != nil {
450: 		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
451: 			result.Status = ReviewCancelled
452: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())})
453: 			if !req.DryRun && !req.PromptOnly {
454: 				return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), err)
455: 			}
456: 		}
457: 		return result, err
458: 	}
459: 	result.Prompt, err = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, renderReviewPreview(m))
460: 	if err != nil {
461: 		return result, err
462: 	}
463: 	if req.DryRun || req.PromptOnly {
464: 		result.Message = "review dry run"
465: 		return result, nil
466: 	}
467: 	if s.runtime == nil {
468: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("runtime is required for review")
469: 	}
470: 	if req.Restart && len(req.Focus) > 0 {
471: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("--restart cannot be combined with focused review")
472: 	}
473: 	result.Status = ReviewRunning
474: 	result.Restarted = req.Restart
475: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); err != nil {
476: 		return result, err
477: 	}
478: 	runCoverage, coverage, focusErr := s.reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Focus)
479: 	if focusErr != nil {
480: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewBlocked, ReviewVerdictBlocked
481: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "focus", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, focusErr.Error())})
482: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), focusErr)
483: 	}
484: 	resumeSessions := map[string]string{}
485: 	completed := 0
486: 	if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
487: 		resume, rebased, resumeErr := s.initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, m, req.Restart)
488: 		if resumeErr != nil {
489: 			result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
490: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-state", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, resumeErr.Error())})
491: 			return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage), resumeErr)
492: 		}
493: 		runCoverage, coverage, resumeSessions, completed = reviewResumePlan(s.root, m, resume)
494: 		result.Resumed = !req.Restart && (completed > 0 || len(resumeSessions) > 0)
495: 		result.Reused = completed
496: 		if rebased > 0 {
497: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "resume-rebased", Message: fmt.Sprintf("reused %d validated reviewer result(s) from the prior input fingerprint; incomplete coverage uses the current snapshot", rebased)})
498: 		}
499: 	}
500: 	reviewerRoot, snapshotErr := prepareReviewSnapshot(m)
501: 	if snapshotErr != nil {
502: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
503: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "snapshot", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, snapshotErr.Error())})
504: 		if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, 0, len(m.Coverage)); saveErr != nil {
505: 			return result, errors.Join(snapshotErr, saveErr)
506: 		}
507: 		return result, snapshotErr
508: 	}
509: 	m.ReviewerRoot = reviewerRoot
510: 	workers := m.Concurrency
511: 	if workers > len(runCoverage) {
512: 		workers = len(runCoverage)
513: 	}
514: 	if workers < 1 {
515: 		workers = 1
516: 	}
517: 	type item struct {
518: 		index     int
519: 		value     ReviewCoverageResult
520: 		sessionID string
521: 	}
522: 	type sessionItem struct {
523: 		coverageID string
524: 		sessionID  string
525: 	}
526: 	jobs := make(chan int)
527: 	done := make(chan item, len(runCoverage))
528: 	sessions := make(chan sessionItem, max(1, len(runCoverage)*4))
529: 	var wg sync.WaitGroup
530: 	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
531: 		wg.Add(1)
532: 		go func() {
533: 			defer wg.Done()
534: 			for i := range jobs {
535: 				c := runCoverage[i]
536: 				sessionID := resumeSessions[c.ID]
537: 				lastSessionID := sessionID
538: 				value, finalSessionID := s.runReviewer(ctx, m, c, sessionID, func(id string) {
539: 					if id != "" && id != lastSessionID {
540: 						lastSessionID = id
541: 						sessions <- sessionItem{coverageID: c.ID, sessionID: id}
542: 					}
543: 				})
544: 				done <- item{index: i, value: value, sessionID: finalSessionID}
545: 			}
546: 		}()
547: 	}
548: 	go func() {
549: 		for i := range runCoverage {
550: 			jobs <- i
551: 		}
552: 		close(jobs)
553: 		wg.Wait()
554: 		close(sessions)
555: 		close(done)
556: 	}()
557: 	var progressSaveErr error
558: 	completedSessionIDs := map[string]bool{}
559: 	for done != nil || sessions != nil {
560: 		select {
561: 		case session, ok := <-sessions:
562: 			if !ok {
563: 				sessions = nil
564: 				continue
565: 			}
566: 			if session.sessionID != "" && len(req.Focus) == 0 {
567: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, session.coverageID, session.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
568: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		case got, ok := <-done:
572: 			if !ok {
573: 				done = nil
574: 				continue
575: 			}
576: 			if got.value.Error == "" && !reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, got.value) {
577: 				got.value.Error = "reviewer result failed schema or citation validation"
578: 			}
579: 			for i := range m.Coverage {
580: 				if m.Coverage[i].ID == got.value.CoverageID {
581: 					coverage[i] = got.value
582: 					break
583: 				}
584: 			}
585: 			completed++
586: 			if got.sessionID != "" {
587: 				completedSessionIDs[got.sessionID] = true
588: 			}
589: 			if req.Progress != nil {
590: 				req.Progress(ReviewProgress{Completed: completed, Total: len(coverage), CoverageID: got.value.CoverageID, Message: "reviewer complete"})
591: 			}
592: 			result.Coverage = coverage
593: 			if len(req.Focus) == 0 {
594: 				if saveErr := s.saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, m.Fingerprint, got.value, got.sessionID); saveErr != nil {
595: 					progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
596: 				}
597: 			}
598: 			if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); saveErr != nil {
599: 				progressSaveErr = errors.Join(progressSaveErr, saveErr)
600: 			}
601: 		}
602: 	}
603: 	result.Coverage = coverage
604: 	validatedFindings, validationDiagnostics, validatedVerdict := validateReviewCoverage(s.root, m, coverage)
605: 	result.Findings = validatedFindings
606: 	result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, validationDiagnostics...)
607: 	result.Verdict = validatedVerdict
608: 	if progressSaveErr != nil {
609: 		result.Status, result.Verdict = ReviewFailed, ReviewVerdictBlocked
610: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "state-write-failed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, progressSaveErr.Error())})
611: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), progressSaveErr)
612: 	}
613: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
614: 		result.Status = ReviewCancelled
615: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "cancelled", Message: ctx.Err().Error()})
616: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), ctx.Err())
617: 	}
618: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewVerdictBlocked {
619: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
620: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("review failed to produce complete valid coverage"))
621: 	}
622: 	current, currentFindings, currentErr := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, req)
623: 	if currentErr != nil || len(currentFindings) > 0 || current.Fingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
624: 		for _, message := range reviewManifestChanges(m, current, currentFindings, currentErr) {
625: 			result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "inputs-changed", Message: safeReviewText(s.root, message)})
626: 		}
627: 	}
628: 	result.Status = ReviewCompleted
629: 	content := RenderReviewMarkdown(m, result)
630: 	if vf := ValidateReviewContent(content, m); len(vf) > 0 {
631: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
632: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "artifact-invalid", Message: vf[0].Problem})
633: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), fmt.Errorf("generated review.md failed validation"))
634: 	}
635: 	path, _ := ArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview)
636: 	if err := atomicWriteReview(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
637: 		result.Status = ReviewFailed
638: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, ReviewDiagnostic{Code: "write-failed", Message: safeError(err)})
639: 		return s.persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage), err)
640: 	}
641: 	now := s.now().UTC()
642: 	result.Message = "review complete"
643: 	result.Artifact = ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
644: 	if err := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, len(coverage)); err != nil {
645: 		return result, err
646: 	}
647: 	publications, publishErr := s.publishReviewStage(ctx, sp)
648: 	result.Publications = append(result.Publications, publications...)
649: 	if publishErr != nil {
650: 		return result, publishErr
651: 	}
652: 	_ = os.RemoveAll(reviewerRoot)
653: 	_ = now
654: 	if result.Verdict == ReviewFail {
655: 		return result, fmt.Errorf("review completed with failing verdict")
656: 	}
657: 	for sessionID := range completedSessionIDs {
658: 		_ = s.deleteCompletedSession(ctx, sessionID)
659: 	}
660: 	return result, nil
661: }

663: func (s Service) persistReviewFailure(projectRef, sprintRef string, result ReviewResult, completed, total int, cause error) (ReviewResult, error) {
664: 	if saveErr := s.saveReviewState(projectRef, sprintRef, result, completed, total); saveErr != nil {
665: 		return result, errors.Join(cause, fmt.Errorf("persist terminal review state: %w", saveErr))
666: 	}
667: 	return result, cause
668: }

670: func (s Service) reviewCoveragePlan(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, focus []string) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, error) {
671: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
672: 	if len(focus) == 0 {
673: 		return m.Coverage, coverage, nil
674: 	}
675: 	wanted := map[string]bool{}
676: 	for _, raw := range focus {
677: 		for _, id := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
678: 			id = strings.TrimSpace(id)
679: 			if id != "" {
680: 				wanted[id] = true
681: 			}
682: 		}
683: 	}
684: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, filepath.FromSlash(m.SprintRoot))})
685: 	if err != nil || state.Review == nil || state.Review.LastComplete == nil {
686: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires a previous complete review with retained coverage")
687: 	}
688: 	previous := state.Review.LastComplete
689: 	if previous.InputFingerprint != m.Fingerprint {
690: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review cannot retain coverage from a different input fingerprint")
691: 	}
692: 	retained := map[string]ReviewCoverageResult{}
693: 	for _, item := range previous.Coverage {
694: 		retained[item.CoverageID] = item
695: 	}
696: 	var run []ReviewInput
697: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
698: 		if wanted[item.ID] {
699: 			run = append(run, item)
700: 			delete(wanted, item.ID)
701: 			continue
702: 		}
703: 		prior, ok := retained[item.ID]
704: 		if !ok || prior.Error != "" {
705: 			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review lacks valid retained coverage %q", item.ID)
706: 		}
707: 		coverage[i] = prior
708: 	}
709: 	if len(wanted) > 0 {
710: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review names unknown coverage")
711: 	}
712: 	if len(run) == 0 {
713: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("focused review requires at least one coverage id")
714: 	}
715: 	return run, coverage, nil
716: }

718: func (s Service) initializeReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef string, m ReviewManifest, restart bool) (ReviewResumeState, int, error) {
719: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
720: 	if err != nil {
721: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
722: 	}
723: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
724: 	if err != nil {
725: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
726: 	}
727: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.ActiveAttempt == nil {
728: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, fmt.Errorf("review attempt state is unavailable")
729: 	}
730: 	current := state.Review.Resume
731: 	rebased := 0
732: 	if restart || !reviewResumeCompatible(current, m) {
733: 		checkpoints := make([]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, 0, len(m.Coverage))
734: 		now := s.now().UTC()
735: 		prior := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
736: 		if !restart && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(current, m) {
737: 			for _, checkpoint := range current.Coverage {
738: 				prior[checkpoint.CoverageID] = checkpoint
739: 			}
740: 		}
741: 		for _, item := range m.Coverage {
742: 			checkpoint := ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{CoverageID: item.ID, Status: AttemptPending, UpdatedAt: now}
743: 			if previous, ok := prior[item.ID]; ok && previous.Status == AttemptCompleted && previous.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(s.root, m, *previous.Result) {
744: 				checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
745: 				checkpoint.Result = previous.Result
746: 				rebased++
747: 			}
748: 			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, checkpoint)
749: 		}
750: 		current = &ReviewResumeState{
751: 			AttemptID:        state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID,
752: 			InputFingerprint: m.Fingerprint,
753: 			Model:            m.Model,
754: 			UpdatedAt:        now,
755: 			Coverage:         checkpoints,
756: 		}
757: 	} else {
758: 		current.AttemptID = state.Review.ActiveAttempt.ID
759: 		current.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
760: 	}
761: 	state.Review.Resume = current
762: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state); err != nil {
763: 		return ReviewResumeState{}, 0, err
764: 	}
765: 	return *current, rebased, nil
766: }
767: 
768: func reviewResumeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
769: 	return state != nil && state.InputFingerprint == m.Fingerprint && reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state, m)
770: }
771: 
772: func reviewResumeShapeCompatible(state *ReviewResumeState, m ReviewManifest) bool {
773: 	if state == nil || state.Model != m.Model || len(state.Coverage) != len(m.Coverage) {
774: 		return false
775: 	}
776: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
777: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {
778: 		seen[item.CoverageID] = true
779: 	}
780: 	for _, item := range m.Coverage {
781: 		if !seen[item.ID] {
782: 			return false
783: 		}
784: 	}
785: 	return true
786: }
787: 
788: func reviewResumePlan(root string, m ReviewManifest, state ReviewResumeState) ([]ReviewInput, []ReviewCoverageResult, map[string]string, int) {
789: 	checkpoints := map[string]ReviewCoverageCheckpoint{}
790: 	for _, item := range state.Coverage {
791: 		checkpoints[item.CoverageID] = item
792: 	}
793: 	coverage := make([]ReviewCoverageResult, len(m.Coverage))
794: 	sessions := map[string]string{}
795: 	run := make([]ReviewInput, 0, len(m.Coverage))
796: 	completed := 0
797: 	for i, item := range m.Coverage {
798: 		checkpoint := checkpoints[item.ID]
799: 		if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted && checkpoint.Result != nil && reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(root, m, *checkpoint.Result) {
800: 			coverage[i] = *checkpoint.Result
801: 			completed++
802: 			continue
803: 		}
804: 		if checkpoint.SessionID != "" && state.InputFingerprint == m.Fingerprint {
805: 			sessions[item.ID] = checkpoint.SessionID
806: 		}
807: 		run = append(run, item)
808: 	}
809: 	return run, coverage, sessions, completed
810: }
811: 
812: func reviewCoverageCheckpointValid(root string, m ReviewManifest, result ReviewCoverageResult) bool {
813: 	if result.Error != "" {
814: 		return false
815: 	}
816: 	single := m
817: 	single.Coverage = []ReviewInput{{ID: result.CoverageID}}
818: 	_, diagnostics, _ := validateReviewCoverage(root, single, []ReviewCoverageResult{result})
819: 	return len(diagnostics) == 0
820: }

822: func (s Service) saveReviewResumeSession(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID, sessionID string) error {
823: 	return s.updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID, func(checkpoint *ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, now time.Time) {
824: 		// Session events and completed results arrive on separate channels. A
825: 		// buffered session event may therefore be persisted after the terminal
826: 		// result; never let that late event restore a cleared session or regress a
827: 		// terminal checkpoint to running.
828: 		if checkpoint.Status == AttemptCompleted || checkpoint.Status == AttemptFailed {
829: 			return
830: 		}
831: 		checkpoint.SessionID = sessionID
832: 		checkpoint.Status = AttemptRunning
833: 		checkpoint.UpdatedAt = now
834: 	})
835: }
836: 
837: func (s Service) saveReviewResumeResult(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint string, result ReviewCoverageResult, sessionID string) error {
838: 	return s.updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, result.CoverageID, func(checkpoint *ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, now time.Time) {
839: 		checkpoint.UpdatedAt = now
840: 		if result.Error == "" {
841: 			checkpoint.SessionID = ""
842: 			checkpoint.Status = AttemptCompleted
843: 			copy := result
844: 			checkpoint.Result = &copy
845: 		} else {
846: 			checkpoint.SessionID = sessionID
847: 			checkpoint.Status = AttemptFailed
848: 			checkpoint.Result = nil
849: 		}
850: 	})
851: }
852: 
853: func (s Service) updateReviewResume(projectRef, sprintRef, fingerprint, coverageID string, update func(*ReviewCoverageCheckpoint, time.Time)) error {
854: 	sp, _, _, err := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
855: 	if err != nil {
856: 		return err
857: 	}
858: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
859: 	if err != nil {
860: 		return err
861: 	}
862: 	if state.Review == nil || state.Review.Resume == nil || state.Review.Resume.InputFingerprint != fingerprint {
863: 		return fmt.Errorf("review resume checkpoint no longer matches active inputs")
864: 	}
865: 	now := s.now().UTC()
866: 	if state.Review.ActiveAttempt != nil {
867: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt.HeartbeatAt = now
868: 		state.Review.ActiveAttempt.OwnerPID = os.Getpid()
869: 	}
870: 	for i := range state.Review.Resume.Coverage {
871: 		if state.Review.Resume.Coverage[i].CoverageID == coverageID {
872: 			update(&state.Review.Resume.Coverage[i], now)
873: 			state.Review.Resume.UpdatedAt = now
874: 			return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
875: 		}
876: 	}
877: 	return fmt.Errorf("review resume checkpoint missing coverage %q", coverageID)
878: }

880: func (s Service) ValidateReview(projectRef, sprintRef string) (ValidationResult, error) {
881: 	m, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
882: 	if err != nil {
883: 		return ValidationResult{}, err
884: 	}
885: 	sp, _, _, _ := s.resolveSprintInputs(projectRef, sprintRef)
886: 	path := ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview)
887: 	if len(findings) == 0 {
888: 		data, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifact(sp, StageReview)
889: 		if readErr != nil {
890: 			findings = append(findings, finding("review.md", "", path, "missing review", readErr.Error(), "Run the review stage."))
891: 		} else {
892: 			findings = append(findings, ValidateReviewContent(data, m)...)
893: 		}
894: 	}
895: 	return ValidationResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, Artifact: path, Findings: findings}, nil
896: }

898: func (s Service) runReviewer(ctx context.Context, m ReviewManifest, c ReviewInput, resumeSession string, onSession func(string)) (out ReviewCoverageResult, sessionID string) {
899: 	out.CoverageID = c.ID
900: 	defer func() {
901: 		if r := recover(); r != nil {
902: 			out.Error = fmt.Sprintf("reviewer panic: %v", r)
903: 		}
904: 	}()
905: 	stagePrompt := renderReviewerPrompt(m, c)
906: 	if resumeSession != "" {
907: 		stagePrompt = "Resume the interrupted review using the refreshed frozen snapshot paths in this request. " + stagePrompt
908: 	}
909: 	prompt, composeErr := composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, stagePrompt)
910: 	if composeErr != nil {
911: 		out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, composeErr.Error())
912: 		return
913: 	}
914: 	req := s.runtimeRequest(prompt, map[string]string{"project": m.Project, "sprint": m.Sprint, "stage": string(StageReview), "coverage": c.ID, "model_source": m.ModelSource})
915: 	req.WorkDir = m.ReviewerRoot
916: 	req.Model = strings.TrimPrefix(m.Model, req.Provider+"/")
917: 	req.Sandbox = "read_only"
918: 	req.Permissions = "restricted"
919: 	req.RequireCaps = appendUnique(req.RequireCaps, "permissions")
920: 	req.Policy = pruntime.PermissionPolicy{Default: "deny", Tools: map[string]string{"read": "allow", "list": "allow", "search": "allow"}}
921: 	captured := &reviewOutputCapture{}
922: 	req.Validation = s.reviewValidationSpec(m, c, captured)
923: 	if resumeSession != "" {
924: 		req.SessionID, req.SessionAction = resumeSession, "continue"
925: 	}
926: 	previousOnEvent := req.OnEvent
927: 	req.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
928: 		captured.observe(event.Payload)
929: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
930: 			previousOnEvent(event)
931: 		}
932: 		if event.SessionID != "" {
933: 			if onSession != nil {
934: 				onSession(event.SessionID)
935: 			}
936: 		}
937: 	}
938: 	sp := Sprint{Project: m.Project, Slug: m.Sprint, Path: filepath.Join(s.root, "projects", m.Project, "sprints", m.Sprint)}
939: 	r, err := s.startSprintRuntime(ctx, sp, StageReview, req)
940: 	sessionID = r.SessionID
941: 	if sessionID != "" && onSession != nil {
942: 		onSession(sessionID)
943: 	}
944: 	if r.Permissions.UnsupportedCount > 0 {
945: 		out.Error = "runtime could not enforce review permission policy"
946: 		return
947: 	}
948: 	if ctx.Err() != nil {
949: 		out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, ctx.Err().Error())
950: 		return
951: 	}
952: 	candidate, problems := extractValidatedReviewResult(s.root, m, c.ID, r)
953: 	if err == nil && len(problems) == 0 {
954: 		return candidate, sessionID
955: 	}
956: 	// The production AgentWrap stack already performed its bounded repairs.
957: 	// Runtime implementations without that wrapper retain a small equivalent
958: 	// fallback here so the product boundary remains deterministic in tests and
959: 	// alternate adapters.
960: 	if r.Validation.Configured {
961: 		if len(problems) == 0 && !r.Validation.Passed && len(r.Validation.Details) > 0 {
962: 			problems = append(problems, r.Validation.Details...)
963: 		}
964: 		if len(problems) > 0 {
965: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, strings.Join(problems, "; "))
966: 		} else if err != nil {
967: 			out.Error = safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())
968: 		}
969: 		return
970: 	}
971: 	if len(problems) == 0 && err != nil {
972: 		problems = []string{safeReviewText(s.root, err.Error())}
973: 	}
974: 	for attempt := 1; attempt <= 2; attempt++ {
975: 		repair := req
976: 		repair.Validation = nil
977: 		repair.Prompt, composeErr = composeStagePromptChecked(m.SharedPrefix, buildReviewRepairPrompt(m, c, problems, r.TerminalOutput))
978: 		if composeErr != nil {

198: 		if !errors.Is(err, ErrFlowStateMissing) {
199: 			return err
200: 		}
201: 		snap, readErr := s.store.ReadArtifacts(sp)
202: 		if readErr != nil {
203: 			return readErr
204: 		}
205: 		state = NewFlowState(sp, DeriveStages(sp, snap, nil), s.now())
206: 	}
207: 	now := s.now().UTC()
208: 	current := state.Smoke
209: 	if current == nil {
210: 		current = &SmokeStageState{Path: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke)}
211: 	}
212: 	if !terminal {
213: 		current.Status = SmokeRunning
214: 		current.ActiveAttempt = &VerificationAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("smoke-%d", now.UnixNano()), Status: AttemptRunning, StartedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now, OwnerPID: os.Getpid()}
215: 	} else {
216: 		attempt := VerificationAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("smoke-%d", now.UnixNano()), StartedAt: now}
217: 		if current.ActiveAttempt != nil {
218: 			attempt = *current.ActiveAttempt
219: 		}
220: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
221: 		attempt.Status = smokeAttemptStatus(result.Status, runErr)
222: 		if se, ok := AsSmokeError(runErr); ok {
223: 			attempt.Category, attempt.Diagnostics, attempt.NextAction = se.Category, []string{safeError(se)}, se.Guidance
224: 		}
225: 		current.ActiveAttempt, current.LastAttempt, current.Status = nil, &attempt, result.Status
226: 		if current.LastComplete != nil && result.Status != SmokeCompleted {
227: 			current.Verdict, current.RunID, current.EvidenceID = current.LastComplete.Verdict, current.LastComplete.RunID, current.LastComplete.EvidenceID
228: 		}
229: 	}
230: 	state.Smoke = current
231: 	return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
232: }

234: func smokeAttemptStatus(status SmokeExecutionStatus, err error) AttemptStatus {
235: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || status == SmokeCancelled {
236: 		return AttemptCancelled
237: 	}
238: 	if se, ok := AsSmokeError(err); ok {
239: 		if se.Category == "timeout" {
240: 			return AttemptTimedOut
241: 		}
242: 		if se.Category == "review_gate" || se.Category == "catalog" {
243: 			return AttemptBlocked
244: 		}
245: 	}
246: 	if status == SmokeCompleted {
247: 		return AttemptCompleted
248: 	}
249: 	return AttemptFailed
250: }

304: func validateSmokeRun(p smokePrepared, discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection, response smokeRunResponse, proc pprocess.Result) ([]SmokeEvidence, []SmokeIssue, []SmokeTestResult, error) {
305: 	if response.SchemaVersion != 1 || response.ProtocolVersion != p.Manifest.ProtocolVersion || response.HarnessID != p.Manifest.Harness.ID || response.RunID == "" {
306: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_identity", "evidence", "run identity does not match manifest/discovery", "Inspect the external run response.", nil)
307: 	}
308: 	if response.ScopeKind != selection.Kind || strings.Join(response.Scope, ",") != strings.Join(selection.IDs, ",") {
309: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_scope", "evidence", "reported scope does not match the request", "Fix the harness scope identity.", nil)
310: 	}
311: 	c := response.Counts
312: 	if c.Total < 0 || c.Passed < 0 || c.Failed < 0 || c.Skipped < 0 || c.Errors < 0 || c.Passed+c.Failed+c.Skipped+c.Errors != c.Total {
313: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_counts", "evidence", "result counts are inconsistent", "Fix the harness count summary.", nil)
314: 	}
315: 	if response.DurationMs < 0 || len(response.Evidence) == 0 {
316: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_missing", "evidence", "duration or evidence identity is missing", "Emit complete protocol-v1 evidence.", nil)
317: 	}
318: 	expected := expectedSmokeTests(discovery, selection)
319: 	actual := make([]string, 0, len(response.Tests))
320: 	statusCounts := SmokeCountsWire{}
321: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
322: 		if test.ID == "" {
323: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an empty test identity", "Return every executed discovered test identity.", nil)
324: 		}
325: 		actual = append(actual, test.ID)
326: 		switch test.Status {
327: 		case "passed":
328: 			statusCounts.Passed++
329: 		case "failed":
330: 			statusCounts.Failed++
331: 		case "skipped":
332: 			statusCounts.Skipped++
333: 		case "error":
334: 			statusCounts.Errors++
335: 		default:
336: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an unsupported test status", "Use passed, failed, skipped, or error.", nil)
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	statusCounts.Total = len(response.Tests)
340: 	sort.Strings(expected)
341: 	sort.Strings(actual)
342: 	if strings.Join(expected, "\x00") != strings.Join(actual, "\x00") || statusCounts != c {
343: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "executed test identities/statuses do not match discovery and counts", "Run exactly the selected discovered tests and return their identities.", nil)
344: 	}
345: 	var evidence []SmokeEvidence
346: 	for _, item := range response.Evidence {
347: 		root := p.RunsRoot
348: 		if item.Kind == "issue" {
349: 			root = p.IssuesRoot
350: 		}
351: 		full := item.Path
352: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
354: 		}
355: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(root, full)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_path", "evidence", "evidence path escapes or is missing", "Keep evidence inside declared roots.", err)
358: 		}
359: 		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
360: 		if err != nil {
361: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
362: 		}
363: 		hash, err := hashFile(resolved)
364: 		if err != nil {
365: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
366: 		}
367: 		if item.SHA256 != "" && !strings.EqualFold(item.SHA256, hash) {
368: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_hash", "evidence", "evidence hash mismatch", "Restore immutable run evidence or rerun smoke.", nil)
369: 		}
370: 		if !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), response.RunID) && item.Kind != "issue" {
371: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_run", "evidence", "evidence path does not identify the reported run", "Use run-ID-addressed evidence.", nil)
372: 		}
373: 		evidence = append(evidence, SmokeEvidence{Kind: item.Kind, Path: resolved, SHA256: hash, Size: info.Size(), ModifiedAt: info.ModTime().UTC()})
374: 	}
375: 	issues := append([]SmokeIssue(nil), response.Issues...)
376: 	failedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, c.Failed+c.Errors)
377: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
378: 		if test.Status == "failed" || test.Status == "error" {
379: 			failedTests[test.ID] = struct{}{}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 	filedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, len(issues))
383: 	for i := range issues {
384: 		if issues[i].ID == "" || (issues[i].Status != "open" && issues[i].Status != "resolved") {
385: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_identity", "evidence", "issue identity/status is invalid", "Emit open or resolved issue metadata.", nil)
386: 		}
387: 		full := issues[i].Path
388: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
389: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
390: 		}
391: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(p.IssuesRoot, full)
392: 		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), issues[i].ID) {
393: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_path", "evidence", "issue path is missing, escaping, or mismatched", "Use an issue-ID-addressed file under the issues root.", err)
394: 		}
395: 		issues[i].Path = resolved
396: 		if _, failed := failedTests[issues[i].TestID]; failed && issues[i].Status == "open" {
397: 			filedTests[issues[i].TestID] = struct{}{}
398: 		}
399: 		if issues[i].Status == "open" && (issues[i].TestID == "" || issues[i].Severity == "" || issues[i].Title == "" || issues[i].Summary == "" || issues[i].Theory == "" || issues[i].Evidence == "" || issues[i].Action == "") {
400: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_detail", "evidence", "open issue metadata is incomplete", "For every open issue emit test_id, severity, title, summary, theory, evidence, and action.", nil)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	for testID := range failedTests {
404: 		if _, ok := filedTests[testID]; !ok {
405: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_missing", "evidence", "failed test has no detailed open issue: "+testID, "File and return one detailed issue for every failed or errored test.", nil)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if proc.ExitCode != 0 && c.Failed+c.Errors == 0 {
409: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_process_unexplained", "process", "non-zero process exit has no matching failed evidence", "Inspect external evidence before retrying.", nil)
410: 	}
411: 	return evidence, issues, append([]SmokeTestResult(nil), response.Tests...), nil
412: }

414: func expectedSmokeTests(discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection) []string {
415: 	testBySuite := map[string][]string{}
416: 	for _, suite := range discovery.Suites {
417: 		testBySuite[suite.ID] = append([]string(nil), suite.Tests...)
418: 	}
419: 	var out []string
420: 	switch selection.Kind {
421: 	case "test":
422: 		out = append(out, selection.IDs...)
423: 	case "suite":
424: 		for _, suite := range selection.IDs {
425: 			out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
426: 		}
427: 	case "level":
428: 		for _, level := range discovery.Levels {
429: 			if len(selection.IDs) > 0 && level.ID == selection.IDs[0] {
430: 				for _, suite := range level.Suites {
431: 					out = append(out, testBySuite[suite]...)
432: 				}
433: 			}
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 	return out
437: }

439: func (s Service) commitSmoke(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) (SmokeResult, error) {
440: 	content := RenderSmoke(result)
441: 	if findings := ValidateSmokeContent(content); len(findings) > 0 {
442: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_artifact_validation", "validation", findings[0].Problem, findings[0].Suggestion, nil))
443: 	}
444: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, p.Sprint, StageSmoke)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
447: 	}
448: 	if err := atomicWriteFile(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
449: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_persistence", "persistence", "smoke summary could not be committed", "The previous valid summary was preserved.", err))
450: 	}
451: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		result.Reconciliation = true
454: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state could not be loaded", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
455: 	}
456: 	now := s.now().UTC()
457: 	evidenceID := ""
458: 	if len(result.Evidence) > 0 {
459: 		evidenceID = result.Evidence[0].SHA256
460: 	}
461: 	artifactDigest := hashBytes([]byte(content))
462: 	identityRefs := smokeIdentityReferences(p, result)
463: 	inputFingerprint, _ := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(identityRefs)
464: 	refs := make([]EvidenceReference, 0, len(result.Evidence))
465: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
466: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: evidence.Kind, Path: evidence.Path, Digest: evidence.SHA256})
467: 	}
468: 	var override *DiagnosticOverride
469: 	if result.ReviewOverride {
470: 		override = &DiagnosticOverride{Requested: true, Confirmed: true, Rationale: result.OverrideRationale, RequestedAt: now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, ReviewVerdict: string(result.ReviewVerdict)}
471: 	}
472: 	active := (*VerificationAttempt)(nil)
473: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
474: 		active = state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
475: 	}
476: 	state.Smoke = &SmokeStageState{Status: result.Status, Verdict: result.Verdict, Path: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), LastRunAt: &now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, SmokeFingerprint: artifactDigest, ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, ReviewOverride: result.ReviewOverride, Diagnostics: result.Diagnostics, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Evidence: refs, Override: override, ActiveAttempt: active, LastComplete: &SmokeCompletion{Verdict: result.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, CompletedAt: now, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, Evidence: identityRefs, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Override: override}}
477: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint, state); err != nil {
478: 		result.Reconciliation = true
479: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state update failed", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
480: 	}
481: 	return result, nil
482: }

514: 	if len(r.Tests) > 0 {

516: 		for _, test := range r.Tests {

521: 	b.WriteString("### External Evidence Identity And Links\n\n")

541: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Next investigation: %s\n\n", printable(issue.Action))
542: 	}
543: 	if len(r.Diagnostics) == 0 && findings == 0 {
544: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
545: 	} else {

547: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", printable(diagnostic))
548: 		}
549: 	}
550: 	b.WriteString("\n## Open Issues\n\n")
551: 	open := false
552: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {

555: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (%s, test `%s`): `%s`\n", issue.ID, printable(issue.Severity), printable(issue.TestID), issue.Path)
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: 	if !open {
559: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
560: 	}
561: 	b.WriteString("\n## Resolved Issues\n\n")
562: 	resolved := false
563: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
564: 		if issue.Status == "resolved" {
565: 			resolved = true
566: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s`\n", issue.ID, issue.Path)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if !resolved {
570: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
571: 	}
572: 	b.WriteString("\n## Mutation And Safety Check\n\nOnly smoke.md, flow-state.json, manifest-declared harness authoring paths, and manifest-declared external evidence roots were approved for mutation. Product source and governed sprint inputs were identity-checked before and after authoring.\n\n")
573: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Verdict And Next Action\n\nVerdict: `%s`\nNext action: %s\n", r.Verdict, printable(r.NextAction))
574: 	return b.String()
575: }

577: func ValidateSmokeContent(content string) []ValidationFinding {

284: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
285: 	if readErr != nil {
286: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "", ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), "missing smoke summary", safeError(readErr), "Run sprint smoke after a current review."))
287: 	} else {
288: 		findings = append(findings, ValidateSmokeContent(string(data))...)
289: 	}
290: 	state, stateErr := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
291: 	if stateErr != nil {
292: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "flow state unavailable", safeError(stateErr), "Restore valid flow state."))
293: 	} else if state.Smoke == nil {
294: 		findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "smoke state missing", "smoke.md and flow state are not reconciled", "Rerun smoke after reviewing the committed summary."))
295: 	} else if data != nil {
296: 		fingerprint := hashBytes(data)
297: 		if state.Smoke.SmokeFingerprint != fingerprint {
298: 			findings = append(findings, finding("Smoke state", "", FlowStateRelPath(sp), "artifact/state mismatch", "smoke fingerprint differs from flow state", "Reconcile by rerunning smoke; automated recovery is deferred."))
299: 		}
300: 	}
301: 	return ValidationResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageSmoke), Findings: findings}, nil
302: }

304: func validateSmokeRun(p smokePrepared, discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection, response smokeRunResponse, proc pprocess.Result) ([]SmokeEvidence, []SmokeIssue, []SmokeTestResult, error) {
305: 	if response.SchemaVersion != 1 || response.ProtocolVersion != p.Manifest.ProtocolVersion || response.HarnessID != p.Manifest.Harness.ID || response.RunID == "" {
306: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_identity", "evidence", "run identity does not match manifest/discovery", "Inspect the external run response.", nil)
307: 	}
308: 	if response.ScopeKind != selection.Kind || strings.Join(response.Scope, ",") != strings.Join(selection.IDs, ",") {
309: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_scope", "evidence", "reported scope does not match the request", "Fix the harness scope identity.", nil)
310: 	}
311: 	c := response.Counts
312: 	if c.Total < 0 || c.Passed < 0 || c.Failed < 0 || c.Skipped < 0 || c.Errors < 0 || c.Passed+c.Failed+c.Skipped+c.Errors != c.Total {
313: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_counts", "evidence", "result counts are inconsistent", "Fix the harness count summary.", nil)
314: 	}
315: 	if response.DurationMs < 0 || len(response.Evidence) == 0 {
316: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_missing", "evidence", "duration or evidence identity is missing", "Emit complete protocol-v1 evidence.", nil)
317: 	}
318: 	expected := expectedSmokeTests(discovery, selection)
319: 	actual := make([]string, 0, len(response.Tests))
320: 	statusCounts := SmokeCountsWire{}
321: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
322: 		if test.ID == "" {
323: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an empty test identity", "Return every executed discovered test identity.", nil)
324: 		}
325: 		actual = append(actual, test.ID)
326: 		switch test.Status {
327: 		case "passed":
328: 			statusCounts.Passed++
329: 		case "failed":
330: 			statusCounts.Failed++
331: 		case "skipped":
332: 			statusCounts.Skipped++
333: 		case "error":
334: 			statusCounts.Errors++
335: 		default:
336: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "run contains an unsupported test status", "Use passed, failed, skipped, or error.", nil)
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	statusCounts.Total = len(response.Tests)
340: 	sort.Strings(expected)
341: 	sort.Strings(actual)
342: 	if strings.Join(expected, "\x00") != strings.Join(actual, "\x00") || statusCounts != c {
343: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_tests", "evidence", "executed test identities/statuses do not match discovery and counts", "Run exactly the selected discovered tests and return their identities.", nil)
344: 	}
345: 	var evidence []SmokeEvidence
346: 	for _, item := range response.Evidence {
347: 		root := p.RunsRoot
348: 		if item.Kind == "issue" {
349: 			root = p.IssuesRoot
350: 		}
351: 		full := item.Path
352: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
353: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
354: 		}
355: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(root, full)
356: 		if err != nil {
357: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_path", "evidence", "evidence path escapes or is missing", "Keep evidence inside declared roots.", err)
358: 		}
359: 		info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
360: 		if err != nil {
361: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
362: 		}
363: 		hash, err := hashFile(resolved)
364: 		if err != nil {
365: 			return nil, nil, nil, err
366: 		}
367: 		if item.SHA256 != "" && !strings.EqualFold(item.SHA256, hash) {
368: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_hash", "evidence", "evidence hash mismatch", "Restore immutable run evidence or rerun smoke.", nil)
369: 		}
370: 		if !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), response.RunID) && item.Kind != "issue" {
371: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_evidence_run", "evidence", "evidence path does not identify the reported run", "Use run-ID-addressed evidence.", nil)
372: 		}
373: 		evidence = append(evidence, SmokeEvidence{Kind: item.Kind, Path: resolved, SHA256: hash, Size: info.Size(), ModifiedAt: info.ModTime().UTC()})
374: 	}
375: 	issues := append([]SmokeIssue(nil), response.Issues...)
376: 	failedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, c.Failed+c.Errors)
377: 	for _, test := range response.Tests {
378: 		if test.Status == "failed" || test.Status == "error" {
379: 			failedTests[test.ID] = struct{}{}
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 	filedTests := make(map[string]struct{}, len(issues))
383: 	for i := range issues {
384: 		if issues[i].ID == "" || (issues[i].Status != "open" && issues[i].Status != "resolved") {
385: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_identity", "evidence", "issue identity/status is invalid", "Emit open or resolved issue metadata.", nil)
386: 		}
387: 		full := issues[i].Path
388: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(full) {
389: 			full = filepath.Join(p.HarnessRoot, filepath.FromSlash(full))
390: 		}
391: 		resolved, err := canonicalFileInside(p.IssuesRoot, full)
392: 		if err != nil || !strings.Contains(filepath.Base(resolved), issues[i].ID) {
393: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_path", "evidence", "issue path is missing, escaping, or mismatched", "Use an issue-ID-addressed file under the issues root.", err)
394: 		}
395: 		issues[i].Path = resolved
396: 		if _, failed := failedTests[issues[i].TestID]; failed && issues[i].Status == "open" {
397: 			filedTests[issues[i].TestID] = struct{}{}
398: 		}
399: 		if issues[i].Status == "open" && (issues[i].TestID == "" || issues[i].Severity == "" || issues[i].Title == "" || issues[i].Summary == "" || issues[i].Theory == "" || issues[i].Evidence == "" || issues[i].Action == "") {
400: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_detail", "evidence", "open issue metadata is incomplete", "For every open issue emit test_id, severity, title, summary, theory, evidence, and action.", nil)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	for testID := range failedTests {
404: 		if _, ok := filedTests[testID]; !ok {
405: 			return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_issue_missing", "evidence", "failed test has no detailed open issue: "+testID, "File and return one detailed issue for every failed or errored test.", nil)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if proc.ExitCode != 0 && c.Failed+c.Errors == 0 {
409: 		return nil, nil, nil, smokeError("smoke_process_unexplained", "process", "non-zero process exit has no matching failed evidence", "Inspect external evidence before retrying.", nil)
410: 	}
411: 	return evidence, issues, append([]SmokeTestResult(nil), response.Tests...), nil
412: }

414: func expectedSmokeTests(discovery smokeDiscovery, selection smokeSelection) []string {
415: 	testBySuite := map[string][]string{}

432: 				}
433: 			}
434: 		}
435: 	}
436: 	return out
437: }

439: func (s Service) commitSmoke(p smokePrepared, result SmokeResult) (SmokeResult, error) {
440: 	content := RenderSmoke(result)
441: 	if findings := ValidateSmokeContent(content); len(findings) > 0 {
442: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_artifact_validation", "validation", findings[0].Problem, findings[0].Suggestion, nil))
443: 	}
444: 	path, err := ArtifactPath(s.root, p.Sprint, StageSmoke)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, err)
447: 	}
448: 	if err := atomicWriteFile(path, []byte(content)); err != nil {
449: 		return smokeFailedResult(result, smokeError("smoke_persistence", "persistence", "smoke summary could not be committed", "The previous valid summary was preserved.", err))
450: 	}
451: 	state, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		result.Reconciliation = true
454: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state could not be loaded", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
455: 	}
456: 	now := s.now().UTC()
457: 	evidenceID := ""
458: 	if len(result.Evidence) > 0 {
459: 		evidenceID = result.Evidence[0].SHA256
460: 	}
461: 	artifactDigest := hashBytes([]byte(content))
462: 	identityRefs := smokeIdentityReferences(p, result)
463: 	inputFingerprint, _ := refreshEvidenceFingerprint(identityRefs)
464: 	refs := make([]EvidenceReference, 0, len(result.Evidence))
465: 	for _, evidence := range result.Evidence {
466: 		refs = append(refs, EvidenceReference{Kind: evidence.Kind, Path: evidence.Path, Digest: evidence.SHA256})
467: 	}
468: 	var override *DiagnosticOverride
469: 	if result.ReviewOverride {
470: 		override = &DiagnosticOverride{Requested: true, Confirmed: true, Rationale: result.OverrideRationale, RequestedAt: now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, ReviewVerdict: string(result.ReviewVerdict)}
471: 	}
472: 	active := (*VerificationAttempt)(nil)
473: 	if state.Smoke != nil {
474: 		active = state.Smoke.ActiveAttempt
475: 	}
476: 	state.Smoke = &SmokeStageState{Status: result.Status, Verdict: result.Verdict, Path: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), LastRunAt: &now, ReviewFingerprint: result.ReviewFingerprint, SmokeFingerprint: artifactDigest, ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, ReviewOverride: result.ReviewOverride, Diagnostics: result.Diagnostics, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Evidence: refs, Override: override, ActiveAttempt: active, LastComplete: &SmokeCompletion{Verdict: result.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(p.Sprint, StageSmoke), ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest, InputFingerprint: inputFingerprint, CompletedAt: now, RunID: result.RunID, AuthorRunID: result.AuthorRunID, AuthorModel: result.AuthorModel, AuthorChangedPaths: append([]string(nil), result.AuthorChangedPaths...), CoverageMapping: result.CoverageMapping, EvidenceID: evidenceID, Evidence: identityRefs, Issues: append([]SmokeIssue(nil), result.Issues...), Override: override}}
477: 	if err := SaveFlowState(s.root, p.Sprint, state); err != nil {
478: 		result.Reconciliation = true
479: 		return result, smokeError("smoke_reconciliation", "reconciliation", "smoke.md committed but flow state update failed", "Reconcile flow state by rerunning smoke.", err)
480: 	}
481: 	return result, nil
482: }

514: 	if len(r.Tests) > 0 {

521: 	b.WriteString("### External Evidence Identity And Links\n\n")

527: 		}
528: 	}

540: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Supporting evidence: %s\n", printable(issue.Evidence))
541: 		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- Next investigation: %s\n\n", printable(issue.Action))
542: 	}
543: 	if len(r.Diagnostics) == 0 && findings == 0 {
544: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
545: 	} else {
546: 		for _, diagnostic := range r.Diagnostics {
547: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", printable(diagnostic))
548: 		}
549: 	}
550: 	b.WriteString("\n## Open Issues\n\n")
551: 	open := false
552: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
553: 		if issue.Status == "open" {
554: 			open = true
555: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` (%s, test `%s`): `%s`\n", issue.ID, printable(issue.Severity), printable(issue.TestID), issue.Path)
556: 		}
557: 	}
558: 	if !open {
559: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
560: 	}
561: 	b.WriteString("\n## Resolved Issues\n\n")
562: 	resolved := false
563: 	for _, issue := range r.Issues {
564: 		if issue.Status == "resolved" {
565: 			resolved = true
566: 			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- `%s` `%s`\n", issue.ID, issue.Path)
567: 		}
568: 	}
569: 	if !resolved {
570: 		b.WriteString("- none\n")
571: 	}
572: 	b.WriteString("\n## Mutation And Safety Check\n\nOnly smoke.md, flow-state.json, manifest-declared harness authoring paths, and manifest-declared external evidence roots were approved for mutation. Product source and governed sprint inputs were identity-checked before and after authoring.\n\n")
573: 	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "## Verdict And Next Action\n\nVerdict: `%s`\nNext action: %s\n", r.Verdict, printable(r.NextAction))
574: 	return b.String()
575: }

577: func ValidateSmokeContent(content string) []ValidationFinding {
578: 	var findings []ValidationFinding
579: 	if strings.TrimSpace(content) == "" || containsPlaceholder(content) {
580: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "", "", "empty or placeholder smoke summary", "summary is incomplete", "Generate a complete evidence-backed summary."))
581: 	}
582: 	for _, heading := range []string{"Smoke Context", "Review Gate", "Harness And Protocol", "Smoke Authoring", "Selected Scope And Rationale", "Preconditions And Environment", "Safe Invocation", "Run Evidence", "Findings", "Open Issues", "Resolved Issues", "Mutation And Safety Check", "Verdict And Next Action"} {
583: 		if !markdownHeadingPresent(content, heading) {
584: 			findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", heading, "", "missing required section", "section was not found", "Regenerate smoke.md."))
585: 		}
586: 	}
587: 	verdict := SmokeVerdict(fieldBacktick(content, "Verdict:"))
588: 	if !validSmokeVerdict(verdict) {
589: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "Verdict", "", "invalid verdict", string(verdict), "Use one of the five smoke verdicts."))
590: 	}
591: 	for _, forbidden := range []string{"-----BEGIN", "Authorization: Bearer", "\"stdout\":", "\"stderr\":"} {
592: 		if strings.Contains(content, forbidden) {
593: 			findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "Safety", "", "raw or secret-bearing content detected", forbidden, "Keep raw streams and secrets in external evidence only."))
594: 		}
595: 	}
596: 	if !strings.Contains(content, "Next action:") {
597: 		findings = append(findings, finding("smoke.md", "Next Action", "", "next action is missing", "no actionable terminal guidance", "Record the required next action."))
598: 	}
599: 	sortSprintFindings(findings)
600: 	return findings
601: }

603: func classifyProcessSmokeError(stage string, result pprocess.Result, err error) error {
604: 	switch {
605: 	case result.TimedOut:
606: 		return smokeError("smoke_timeout", "timeout", stage+" timed out", "Inspect external evidence and retry with a bounded timeout.", err)
607: 	case result.Cancelled || errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
608: 		return smokeError("smoke_cancelled", "cancellation", stage+" was cancelled", "Confirm cleanup before retrying.", err)
609: 	case !result.CleanupComplete:
610: 		return smokeError("smoke_cleanup", "cleanup", stage+" cleanup is uncertain", "Terminate owned descendants before retrying.", err)
611: 	default:
612: 		return smokeError("smoke_process", "process", stage+" process failed", "Inspect the safe diagnostic and external harness logs.", err)
613: 	}
614: }
615: func smokeFailedResult(result SmokeResult, err error) (SmokeResult, error) {
616: 	result.Status = SmokeFailed
617: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
618: 		result.Status = SmokeCancelled
619: 	}
620: 	if se, ok := AsSmokeError(err); ok {
621: 		result.Diagnostics = append(result.Diagnostics, se.Code+": "+se.Message)
622: 	}
623: 	return result, err
624: }
625: func decodeOneJSON(value string, target any) error {
626: 	dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(strings.TrimSpace(value)))
627: 	if err := dec.Decode(target); err != nil {
628: 		return err
629: 	}
630: 	var extra any
631: 	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err == nil {
632: 		return fmt.Errorf("multiple JSON values")
633: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
634: 		return err
635: 	}
636: 	return nil
637: }
638: func safeArgv(executable string, args []string) string {
639: 	// Manifest argv has no sensitivity metadata, so stable output retains only
640: 	// option names and argument shape. Raw values remain in external evidence.
641: 	values := []string{filepath.Base(executable)}
642: 	for _, value := range args {
643: 		if strings.HasPrefix(value, "-") {
644: 			if name, _, ok := strings.Cut(value, "="); ok {
645: 				values = append(values, name+"=[REDACTED]")
646: 			} else {
647: 				values = append(values, value)
648: 			}
649: 			continue
650: 		}
651: 		values = append(values, "[ARG]")
652: 	}
653: 	for i, value := range values {
654: 		values[i] = fmt.Sprintf("%q", value)
655: 	}
656: 	return strings.Join(values, " ")
657: }
658: func hasOpenSmokeIssues(issues []SmokeIssue) bool {
659: 	for _, issue := range issues {
660: 		if issue.Status == "open" {
661: 			return true
662: 		}

1239: 		current.Resume = nil
1240: 	}
1241: 	if len(r.Focused) > 0 && r.Status == ReviewRunning && completed == 0 && len(r.Coverage) == 0 {
1242: 		current.ActiveAttempt = nil
1243: 		current.Resume = nil
1244: 	}
1245: 	current.Status, current.LastRunAt, current.Completed, current.Total, current.Diagnostics = r.Status, &now, completed, total, append([]ReviewDiagnostic(nil), r.Diagnostics...)
1246: 	current.ProvisionalVerdict = r.ProvisionalVerdict
1247: 	attempt := VerificationAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("review-%d", now.UnixNano()), Status: AttemptRunning, StartedAt: now, HeartbeatAt: now, OwnerPID: os.Getpid()}
1248: 	if current.ActiveAttempt != nil {
1249: 		attempt = *current.ActiveAttempt
1250: 	}
1251: 	if r.Status == ReviewRunning {
1252: 		attempt.HeartbeatAt = now
1253: 		attempt.OwnerPID = os.Getpid()
1254: 		current.ActiveAttempt = &attempt
1255: 		if current.Resume != nil && !r.Restarted {
1256: 			current.Resume.AttemptID = attempt.ID
1257: 		}
1258: 	} else {
1259: 		attempt.CompletedAt = &now
1260: 		attempt.Diagnostics = reviewDiagnosticStrings(r.Diagnostics)
1261: 		attempt.Status = reviewAttemptStatus(r.Status)
1262: 		current.ActiveAttempt, current.LastAttempt = nil, &attempt
1263: 	}
1264: 	if r.Status == ReviewCompleted {
1265: 		current.ProvisionalVerdict = ""
1266: 		digest, _ := hashFile(mustArtifactPath(s.root, sp, StageReview))
1267: 		current.Verdict, current.Fingerprint, current.ArtifactDigest, current.Stale = r.Verdict, r.Fingerprint, digest, false
1268: 		current.LastComplete = &ReviewCompletion{Verdict: r.Verdict, Artifact: ArtifactRelPath(sp, StageReview), ArtifactDigest: digest, InputFingerprint: r.Fingerprint, CompletedAt: now, Coverage: append([]ReviewCoverageResult(nil), r.Coverage...)}
1269: 		current.Resume = nil
1270: 	} else if current.LastComplete != nil {
1271: 		current.Verdict, current.Fingerprint, current.ArtifactDigest = current.LastComplete.Verdict, current.LastComplete.InputFingerprint, current.LastComplete.ArtifactDigest
1272: 	} else {
1273: 		current.Verdict, current.Fingerprint = r.Verdict, r.Fingerprint
1274: 	}
1275: 	state.Review = current
1276: 	return SaveFlowState(s.root, sp, state)
1277: }

1604: func prepareReviewSnapshot(m ReviewManifest) (string, error) {
1605: 	if m.Fingerprint == "" || strings.ContainsAny(m.Fingerprint, "\\/\x00\r\n") {
1606: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("create frozen review snapshot: invalid fingerprint")
1607: 	}
1608: 	root := filepath.Join(m.WorkspaceRoot, ".ultra", "cache", "review", m.Project, m.Sprint, m.Fingerprint)
1609: 	marker := filepath.Join(root, ".complete")
1610: 	if _, err := os.Stat(marker); err == nil {
1611: 		return root, nil
1612: 	}
1613: 	if err := os.RemoveAll(root); err != nil {
1614: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("reset incomplete frozen review snapshot: %w", err)
1615: 	}
1616: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(root, 0o700); err != nil {
1617: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("create frozen review snapshot: %w", err)
1618: 	}
1619: 	cleanup := true
1620: 	defer func() {
1621: 		if cleanup {
1622: 			_ = os.RemoveAll(root)
1623: 		}
1624: 	}()
1625: 	for _, in := range m.Inputs {
1626: 		if in.Kind == "asset" || in.Path == "target/.identity" {
1627: 			continue
1628: 		}
1629: 		content, ok := m.Contents[in.Path]
1630: 		if !ok {
1631: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("frozen review input %q has no captured content", in.Path)
1632: 		}
1633: 		copyManifest := m
1634: 		copyManifest.ReviewerRoot = root
1635: 		path := reviewInputReadPath(copyManifest, in)
1636: 		if !inside(root, path) {
1637: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("frozen review input %q escapes snapshot", in.Path)
1638: 		}
1639: 		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
1640: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("create frozen review snapshot directory: %w", err)
1641: 		}
1642: 		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o400); err != nil {
1643: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("write frozen review input %q: %w", in.Path, err)
1644: 		}
1645: 	}
1646: 	if err := os.WriteFile(marker, []byte(m.Fingerprint+"\n"), 0o400); err != nil {
1647: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("complete frozen review snapshot: %w", err)
1648: 	}
1649: 	cleanup = false
1650: 	return root, nil
1651: }
1652: func extractReviewResult(r pruntime.Result, out *ReviewCoverageResult) bool {
1653: 	if extractReviewValue(r.TerminalOutput, out) {
1654: 		return true
1655: 	}
1656: 	for i := len(r.Events) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
1657: 		if extractReviewValue(r.Events[i].Payload, out) {
1658: 			return true
1659: 		}
1660: 	}
1661: 	return false

1663: func extractReviewValue(v any, out *ReviewCoverageResult) bool {
1664: 	switch x := v.(type) {
1665: 	case map[string]any:
1666: 		var candidate ReviewCoverageResult
1667: 		if raw, e := json.Marshal(x); e == nil && json.Unmarshal(raw, &candidate) == nil && candidate.CoverageID != "" {
1668: 			*out = candidate
1669: 			return true
1670: 		}
1671: 		for _, k := range []string{"review_result", "structured_output", "output", "content", "text", "message", "part"} {
1672: 			if y, ok := x[k]; ok && extractReviewValue(y, out) {
1673: 				return true
1674: 			}
1675: 		}
1676: 	case []any:
1677: 		for i := len(x) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
1678: 			if extractReviewValue(x[i], out) {
1679: 				return true
1680: 			}
1681: 		}
1682: 	case string:
1683: 		return extractReviewJSON(x, out)
1684: 	}
1685: 	return false
1686: }

1688: // extractReviewJSON tolerates runtime output that contains reasoning, Markdown,
1689: // or other prose before the canonical result. Trying each object boundary with
1690: // a streaming decoder avoids the brittle first-"{"/last-"}" assumption while
1691: // still accepting only an object that decodes as an actual review result.
1692: func extractReviewJSON(value string, out *ReviewCoverageResult) bool {
1693: 	found := false
1694: 	for offset := 0; offset < len(value); {
1695: 		relative := strings.IndexByte(value[offset:], '{')
1696: 		if relative < 0 {
1697: 			break
1698: 		}
1699: 		start := offset + relative
1700: 		var candidate ReviewCoverageResult
1701: 		if err := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(value[start:])).Decode(&candidate); err == nil && candidate.CoverageID != "" {
1702: 			*out = candidate
1703: 			found = true
1704: 		}
1705: 		offset = start + 1
1706: 	}
1707: 	return found
1708: }

313: func validateAttempt(attempt *VerificationAttempt, active bool) error {

316: 	}
317: 	if attempt.ID == "" || attempt.StartedAt.IsZero() || strings.ContainsAny(attempt.ID, "\x00\r\n") {
318: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid identity or start time")
319: 	}
320: 	if attempt.OwnerPID < 0 || (!attempt.HeartbeatAt.IsZero() && attempt.HeartbeatAt.Before(attempt.StartedAt)) {
321: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid attempt owner or heartbeat")
322: 	}
323: 	switch attempt.Status {
324: 	case AttemptRunning, AttemptCompleted, AttemptFailed, AttemptCancelled, AttemptTimedOut, AttemptBlocked:
325: 	default:
326: 		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported status %q", attempt.Status)
327: 	}

329: 		return fmt.Errorf("active attempt is not running")
330: 	}

333: 	}
334: 	for _, value := range append(append([]string{}, attempt.Diagnostics...), attempt.Category, attempt.NextAction) {
